jobs.description:
About the company:

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Rice and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About The Role:

In this role, you will develop state of the art instruments to collect data to guide our exploration programs. You will simulate, characterize, and calibrate sensor performance and design new data acquisition systems. Working with vendors and partners, you will build hardware and work with our operations staff to deploy it in the field.

With this sensor data and other data sources at KoBold, you will build models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will be creating models and developing software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will identify new opportunities and technologies for geophysical data collection, create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building and deploying next generation hardware and using data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Responsibilities of this position include:

Technical execution

  • Design, develop, and deploy new mineral exploration data collection instruments and methods.
  • Help develop KoBold’s proprietary software exploration tools.
  • Find and curate a wide variety of geospectral, geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.
  • Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.
  • Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.
  • Develop and apply a range of data processing, statistical, and physics-based techniques to geoscientific data — from computer vision to geophysical inversions — and use the results to guide our targeting efforts and inform our acquisition and exploration decisions.
  • Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders.
  • Push the state of the art in analysis capabilities by implementing statistically rigorous spatially aware clustering, anomaly detection, and other analysis methods
  • Collaborate with data scientists, geoscientists and engineers to invent and deploy algorithms that combine large and complex data sets for mineral exploration and discoveries

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly absorb and synthesize complex information, with a track record of high intellectual rigor in a professional setting.
  • Exceptional curiosity and eagerness to learn, with a proactive approach to exploring new concepts and technologies.
  • A successful track record of developing complex equipment with cross-disciplinary teams and vendors.

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

  • Physical measurement and data analysis systems that use phenomena such as optics, electromagnetism, radiation, and gravity.
  • Applying scientific knowledge to identify and prototype emerging technologies
  • Systems integration and data acquisition.
  • Python’s data science packages and general software engineering practices.
  • Collaborative software development (git), and familiarity with software engineering best practices like unit test / integration test suites, and CICD pipelines.
  • SQL, as well as familiarity with non-relational databases.
  • Cloud computing resources.
  • Building a wide variety of predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results.
  • Data analysis, physics analysis, and applied statistics on a broad range of types of data including data from physical systems.
  • Capacity to dive deep on novel challenging problems in applying ML to mineral exploration, including understanding a complex domain of geology and mineral exploration practices as well as working with limited, disparate and noisy data sources
  • Experience deploying sensors in the field

Work practices and motivation:

  • Ability to take ownership and responsibility of large projects.
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Open to working directly with geologists in the field. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights and innovations.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who aren’t software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
  • Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively.

It is also helpful but not required to have experience with:

  • Remote sensing
  • Creating machine learning models on geospatial data
  • Image processing or computer vision
  • Project and team management

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is Full-time Exempt

In addition to salary, we offer equity compensation. We also offer benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer paid sick time and parental leave."

Position Description & Requirements
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:
Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.
The Recruitment Operations Partner is a strategic individual contributor responsible for optimizing recruiting operations, improving the candidate experience, and enabling recruiter productivity at scale. This role supports process execution, operational insights, and continuous improvement initiatives across the recruiting lifecycle while partnering with recruiters, hiring leaders, HR stakeholders, and technology teams to ensure recruiting operations and sourcing activities are efficient, data-driven, and aligned with business priorities.

POSITION SUMMARY:

  • Own end-to-end interview operations, ensuring seamless scheduling, candidate communications, and stakeholder coordination across functions and time zones.
  • Support candidate sourcing efforts for an assigned vertical and recruiting team by partnering closely with recruiters to build and maintain qualified talent pipelines.
  • Conduct sourcing activities such as talent research, resume review, candidate outreach, and CRM pipeline management.
  • Serve as an operational escalation point for complex or high-priority recruiting activity.
  • Evaluate recruiting workflows and sourcing processes to improve speed, quality, and candidate experience.
  • Maintain data integrity across applicant tracking system and customer relationship management platforms.
  • Support accurate tracking of sourcing activities and candidate pipeline status.
  • Manage requisition lifecycle activities, including job posting creation and updates.
  • Support recruiting metrics, dashboards, and reporting to inform decision-making.
  • Develop and document recruiting and sourcing standard operating procedures and playbooks.

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3–5 years of experience in recruiting operations, coordination, or talent operations
  • Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered
  • Knowledge of recruiting operations, sourcing practices, applicant tracking systems, customer relationship management tools, and recruiting process workflows
  • Skill in scheduling and coordination, candidate communication, process documentation, reporting, data accuracy, and use of Microsoft Office products and recruiting technologies

WHY RADIOLOGY PARTNERS:

  • Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
  • Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
  • Flexible Remote Schedules Generous
  • PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
  • Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years

FOR MORE INFORMATION:

Recruitment Operations Partner
COMPENSATION:
The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $90,000 Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).
Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

CCPA Notice:

When you submit a job application or resume, you are providing the Practice with the following categories of personal information that the Practice will use for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for employment: (1) Personal Identifiers; and (2) Education and Employment History.
Radiology Partners participates in E-verify.

Beware of Fraudulent Messages:

Radiology Partners will never request payment, banking or other financial information in exchange for interviews or as part of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not send checks for deposit into your bank account at any stage of recruitment. All communication during the interview and hiring process should come from an email address ending in “@radpartners.com.” If you suspect you are receiving a fraudulent job offer or solicitation from Radiology Partners or one of our local practices, please email to notify our team.

jobs.title: Accounts Lead (Remote, UK/EU - £60-65k)
jobs.excerpt: Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies.
jobs.description:
Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimization, and performance reporting.

This is a new role that further builds out our commercial function. You will be joining us at a very exciting time.

What you will own

You will own Ellipsis’ client relationships. Every client should always know what we're doing, why, and what it's achieving -- without having to ask. The book should grow through renewals, expansions, referrals, and case studies.

Ellipsis is an AI search agency, and our customers are predominantly B2B technology companies. We work with a lot of startups and scale-ups; B2B tech has been our bread-and-butter although we are also having success with B2C and have some very high profile clients in this area.

We are UK-based but fully remote and have been since day 1, 8 years ago. A lot of the team is UK based, our core business hours are UK, but we are fully remote and there is no location requirement for this role. Our clients are a mix of UK, Europe, and US-based.

Sales and delivery are working well. The gap is the layer in between: after a client signs, nobody formally owns the relationship; the story of what we’re doing and why, the communications, the renewals, the expansion conversations. Today that’s informally covered by the MD/ Founder, which caps how much the business can grow and means things slip during busy periods.

Your role will be to take this over, own key accounts, and have impact across the whole business. Success looks like retaining our customers, successfully expanding and renewing accounts, and collaborating tightly with Operations, Strategy, and Sales to further our continuous improvement and growth.

You will report directly to the MD/ Founder and be expected to contribute as a senior leader in the team.

Supporting signals will be seen in the day-to-day: clients are not chasing us to find out what’s happening, call prep and calls have a clear story running through the deck that you own, you are nudging Operations and Strategy to ensure the voice of the customer is heard internally; and expansions, case studies, and referrals happen because someone owns them.

What you'd do

Own the story for each client. What they bought, what they want, what we've done, what's next -- and tell it clearly. The team preps the data and analysis; you make it land. You own the narrative in client decks and calls.

Run the communication rhythm. At the start of each week, quick updates to clients via Slack (what we did, what’s next, what’s blocked, performance highlights); ad-hoc comms throughout the week via email and Slack, and either monthly or fortnightly calls depending on the client.

Understand our clients’ businesses so you can contribute and expand. Ellipsis has an extremely consultative sales process and our clients trust us as experts. In many instances, we’re brought in to do “GEO” but end up as a strategic marketing partner. This creates expansion opportunities which you can pursue as long as you understand their business and where we can contribute more -- expansion and adding value go hand-in-hand and we build for the long-term success of the business.

Be curious about AI search and strategy. AI search is changing quickly and Ellipsis is leading that change. We are constantly producing new research, looking at data, and optimizing our approach. You will work with a Strategy Lead for each account (and the Head of Strategy across the business) but need to be curious, data literate, and capable of deeply understanding what we’re doing and why -- which will let you confidently hold the room when discussing strategy, and advocate for the client’s needs effectively.

Front the key relationships. For the top ~8-10 accounts, you attend the calls and run the relationship. For the rest, you own the story, ensure internal alignment, and step in on renewals, risk, or expansion (Content Managers front the regular calls).

Own renewals and expansions. Spot and shape upsell opportunities, run the renewal conversations, chase case-study permissions and referrals. You’ll need to both be able to smell adjacent opportunities (we are currently one of the few agencies that can do strategy, copy, and design for a “GEO friendly website”, but don’t advertise this enough!) and guide renewals/expansions (which are always inherently tied to strategy and what more we can do for the customer).

Advocate for the client internally. When work is late or off-brief, you say so and chase it. You represent what the client actually asked for, even when that's uncomfortable.

Report and contribute to planning internally. You’ll join (and lead part of) the Monday morning pipeline and accounts review meeting, where we plan upcoming business and assess the state of renewals and expansion opportunities with existing accounts. You’ll work closely with Operations to ensure we have the right capacity at the right time, and work closely with Sales to ensure you understand incoming prospects and are ready to advocate for their needs internally from day one.

What this role is not

Not a project manager or a status-updater. Not operations -- you flag delivery problems, the ops lead fixes processes. Not new-business sales -- acquisition is covered.

Requirements

You’ll have owned complex and commercially important client relationships. In other UK agencies this is typically a mid-to-senior “Accounts Director” or exceptional “Senior Accounts Manager” role but we’re open to other roles, industries, and experiences.

Marketing or SEO agency experience is probably helpful. You will need to become fluent enough in SEO and AI search to hold the room with a technical, sceptical client -- you don't produce the analysis, but you can defend it; but we’re happy for you to pick this up quickly on the job.

You should be commercially confident: happy to run a renewal and ask for the expansion. Warm with clients, firm internally.

Compensation

£60-65k

There is no individual commission. Renewals and expansions at Ellipsis are team outcomes: Strategy, Content, Design and Operations create the value, while the Accounts Lead ensures clients understand it and leads the commercial conversation. We therefore pay a strong fixed salary and assess success through the long-term retention, health and growth of the client book.

First 90 days

Shadow the founder on the key accounts, then take them over one by one. Ship the onboarding protocol and monthly update rhythm. Baseline the retention numbers. By day 90, you own the top relationships and the founder attends client calls by exception only.

To be successful at Ellipsis, you need to be able to think quickly from first principles, capable of executing quickly, and driven to succeed. Whilst we’re 8 years old, we operate like a startup. The team -- a lot of whom have been with us a long time -- will tell you this is a place to learn quickly, progress quickly, and do your best work.

Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.

Benefits

  • This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach!
  • We have a lot of clients in the US and California, so you'll need to be available for client and new business calls in the 5-7pm UK slot a couple of days a week (generally don't go later than this, but you'll need to be available as needed).
  • 28 days of paid holiday
    • An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days
  • 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays)
  • Genuinely flexible working, although noting the meeting schedule requirements above
  • Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave, and sick pay

The application process

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this.

Much of our company Wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

We'll review applications on a rolling basis but interviews start after the closing date. There's thus no benefit to rushing to apply: we will bias heavily towards your application's answers rather than your CV, and we'd love for you to take your time.

We're fortunate to receive a large volume of applications. You can make your application stand out by paying special attention to the main responsibilities of this role, and "how to apply". If you think you're a fit, or could be a fit – go for it!

We use video calls for interviews. You'll have video interviews using Google Meet, including with members of the Leadership team and the Founder.

We understand that this is as much you interviewing us, as the other way round. Throughout the interview process, we're extremely happy to answer your questions about the business, working here, and the future of the company.

The final stage of our hiring process is a paid test project, which will be similar to work you could expect to do if you were hired. We'll give you a week to complete the project, and expect it to be 4-6 hours of work.

Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :)

How to apply

Please apply through Workable: . We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we're looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this.

Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity.

The deadline for submission is the end of the day, on 13 September 2026.

jobs.title: Customer Success Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: At SEARADAR, we help clients around the world organize seamless yacht charter experiences.
jobs.description:
At SEARADAR, we help clients around the world organize seamless yacht charter experiences.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Team Lead to lead the daily work of our Customer Success team, maintain high service standards, support managers in complex situations, and continuously improve the way we work with clients and charter companies.

This is a hands-on leadership role: we’re looking for someone who can manage people and performance while staying close to real customer cases and operations.

Tasks

Team Leadership

  • Oversee the daily work and performance of Customer Success Managers.
  • Set priorities, distribute workload, and ensure sufficient team coverage.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide feedback, and support the professional development of team members.
  • Monitor individual performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Participate in onboarding and training of new Customer Success Managers.
  • Run regular case reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions with the team.

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Act as the main escalation point for complex or sensitive customer cases.
  • Support managers in finding solutions in non-standard situations involving clients, charter companies, and other partners.
  • Ensure that escalations are handled quickly, professionally, and with appropriate ownership.
  • Help the team make independent, customer-oriented decisions rather than simply following standard scenarios.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and turn them into process improvements.

Performance & Quality

  • Monitor key Customer Success metrics, including NPS, SLA, customer satisfaction, response times, escalations, and retention-related indicators.
  • Maintain consistent service quality across the team.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify areas requiring attention.
  • Develop action plans when team or individual performance falls below expectations.
  • Ensure that customer feedback is translated into concrete improvements.

Processes & Knowledge

  • Build, document, and continuously improve Customer Success processes.
  • Develop internal guidelines, playbooks, templates, and training materials.
  • Ensure the team is informed about relevant product, operational, and process changes.
  • Work with other departments to eliminate recurring operational bottlenecks and improve the overall customer journey.

Charter Companies & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Communicate directly with charter companies when escalation or additional coordination is required.
  • Support prioritization of payments to charter companies based on customer and operational impact.
  • Work closely with Sales, Finance, Supply, and Product teams to resolve issues affecting customers.
  • Ensure important information flows effectively between Customer Success and other departments.

What success looks like

Success in this role means:

  • The CS team operates independently and consistently.
  • NPS and service quality remain at a strong level.
  • SLA and response-time expectations are met.
  • Complex cases are resolved quickly and effectively.
  • Managers understand their performance and continuously develop.
  • Recurring problems are identified and addressed systematically.
  • Clients receive a consistent experience regardless of which manager handles their case.
  • Communication between CS, charter companies, and internal teams runs smoothly.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Account Management, Travel Operations, Hospitality, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Previous experience as a Team Lead, Senior CS Manager, Shift Lead, or in another role involving people management and performance ownership.
  • Strong experience handling complex customer situations and escalations.
  • Ability to coach people, give constructive feedback, and improve team performance.
  • Strong analytical mindset and experience working with customer service KPIs.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • High level of ownership and proactivity.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent English and Russian, both written and spoken.
  • Experience in travel, hospitality, TravelTech, marketplaces, yachting, or complex travel services is a strong advantage.
  • Previous experience working with AMO CRM is a strong advantage.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work in an international team.
  • A high level of ownership and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to directly influence Customer Success standards and processes.
  • A hands-on leadership role with real impact on both the team and customer experience.
  • Opportunity to develop and strengthen the CS function as SEARADAR continues to grow.

jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen es una plataforma que empodera a las personas, independientemente de su experiencia previa, para embarcarse en el emocionante y crucial camino de dominar profesiones tecnológicas. Nuestros bootcamps se enfocan en formar estudiantes en Web Development, Data Science, Data Analysis, QA Engineering, UX/UI Design y Cybersecurity, haciendo que estos campos sean accesibles y alcanzables para todos, para que puedan prosperar en una nueva carrera.

Nuestra misión es asegurar que cada estudiante tenga la oportunidad de dominar una profesión tecnológica, encontrar su propósito y convertirse en un valioso contribuidor en la industria tech. Estamos buscando expertos deCiberseguridad apasionados por la seguridad informática, con experiencia práctica y vocación para guiar a principiantes mientras construyen una base sólida en este campo clave. Este rol requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en ciberseguridad, habilidades de comunicación claras y empatía para apoyar e inspirar a estudiantes que están dando sus primeros pasos en esta área.

﻿¿Te gustaría ayudar a construir el futuro de otras personas a través de la educación tecnológica?

➡️ Te pedimos amablemente que envíes tu CV en inglés.

What you will do

Como experto en proyectos, liderarás a una cohorte de estudiantes a lo largo de nuestro programa de Cybersecurity, compartiendo tu experiencia e inspirándolos con tu conocimiento de la industria. Apoyarás a los estudiantes respondiendo sus preguntas y brindándoles orientación práctica de las siguientes maneras:

  • Impartiendo webinars quincenales enfocados en proyectos, guiando a los estudiantes en la aplicación práctica de conceptos de ciberseguridad y en escenarios reales.
  • Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).
  • Realizando sesiones de mentoría 1:1 bajo demanda, enfocadas en los proyectos, para ayudar a los estudiantes a superar dificultades técnicas y mantenerse motivados durante el programa.
  • Respondiendo preguntas relacionadas con los proyectos en Discord, ayudando a los estudiantes a resolver problemas y profundizar su comprensión de las prácticas de ciberseguridad.
  • Actuando como el experto y mentor de referencia, acompañando a los estudiantes mientras desarrollan sus proyectos y fortalecen sus habilidades en ciberseguridad.

Requirements

Requerimos al menos 3 años de experiencia práctica en ciberseguridad, con conocimientos en las siguientes áreas:

• Network & Architecture: comprensión de redes planas vs. segmentadas, DMZ y estrategias para reducir la superficie de ataque y el blast radius.

• Authentication & Access Abuse: conocimiento de riesgos relacionados con accesos privilegiados, uso de RDP y exportaciones sospechosas de datos.

• Incident Analysis: capacidad para investigar eventos como intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión, restablecimientos de contraseña y actividad sospechosa en cuentas utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.

• Log Analysis: experiencia analizando logs de sistemas y seguridad para detectar anomalías o comportamientos sospechosos.

• Python Scripting: capacidad para escribir scripts que procesen logs, cuenten eventos y extraigan información útil.

• Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara a principiantes.

• Paciencia y empatía al apoyar a estudiantes que están iniciando en ciberseguridad.

• Nivel de inglés B1.

﻿Ventajas adicionales:

• Experiencia previa enseñando o mentoreando.

• Experiencia guiando a principiantes en temas técnicos con explicaciones paso a paso.

What we can offer you

Capacitación en técnicas de mentoría y comunicación.

  • Colaboración flexible, remota y de medio tiempo — trabaja 10-18 horas por semana.
  • Compartir experiencia con desarrolladores dentro de nuestra comunidad.
  • Ingresos promedio de $600 USD al mes por una colaboración flexible de medio tiempo, con gran impacto ¡y un equipo increíble!
  • Experiencia de colaboración intercultural en mentoría y realización de webinars.
  • Cooperación remota con un horario conveniente tanto para ti como para el equipo. No nos enfocamos en la microgestión.
  • Una oficina digital cómoda. Utilizamos herramientas digitales modernas — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — para que el trabajo conjunto sea fluido.
  • Un equipo diverso y unido distribuido entre EE.UU. y América Latina.

¡Estamos emocionados de conocerte y trabajar contigo! ?

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

Position Overview

The Real Estate Manager is responsible for managing and facilitating projects through the site selection process, into design, and supporting through shop opening. This role also drives markets and tracks competitors, retail activity, and growth patterns. In addition, this position will foster relationships with HQ departments, community leaders, government officials, brokers, landlords, Build-To-Suit Developers and vendors in a manner consistent with Dutch Bros’ values.

The Real Estate Manager must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team, have outstanding organizational skills, adapt easily to change, and be able to meet stringent deadlines. This person must be a tenacious project manager that is task-oriented and follows through in order to manage their market territory efficiently. Above all else, this person serves as a Director of First Impressions by having a positive attitude and outlook on life and exemplifying the Dutch Creed.

Key Result Areas

Secure sites at a level to meet company growth goals each year (lease signed, site approved, plans started, and shops opened):

  • Drives markets and tracks competitors, retail activity and growth patterns

  • Utilizes GIS system for demographic and modeling information to develop a growth plan as well as gain industry knowledge and experience

  • Negotiates LOIs and assists in lease negotiations when needed with legal team, franchise partner and landlord, as applicable

  • Reviews and Completes Real Estate Committee (REC) Presentation to ensure adequate information is distributed to the REC for final review and acceptance/rejection

  • Completes field review of all sites submitted by Franchisees and Operating Partners in defined territory within a prescribed time frame, as applicable

  • Partners with construction to aid in communications with landlords/developers as well as meeting deadlines and financial feasibility

Open new Markets each year as directed by the Real Estate Committee:

  • Maintains network of brokers to assist with site acquisition in all target development markets

  • Provides timely and accurate updates on status of all development activities within assigned territory

  • Provides growth plans as a roadmap for company and franchise partner development

Foster relationships with HQ departments, community leaders, government officials, brokers, landlords and vendors in a manner consistent with DB values:

  • Maintains continual communication with HQ departments to keep them aware of site opportunities and assist with their development needs

  • Responds to verbal and written communication from all contacts in a professional and timely fashion

  • Utilizes ICSC, Retail Live and other retail conferences to educate outside partners on site requirements and help source site opportunities to fulfill development efforts

  • Works with Construction, Ops support, Administration and pre-opening support to ensure smooth, timely and successful store openings

  • Closely interacts with the architecture and design teams to ensure the plan development process is timely and that the Franchisees and Operating Partners stay on their development timeline

Skills

  • Site Selection and Evaluation

  • Negotiation and Deal Making

  • Real Estate Market Knowledge

  • Legal and Regulatory Compliance

  • Relationship Building

  • Project Management

  • Communication

  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience, required

  • Minimum of 5 years of commercial real estate-related experience, required

  • Knowledge of build-to suits, leases, land use, development processes, building permits, and construction project management is a plus

  • This position requires driving, a minimum of 40% of time will be spent traveling

Location Requirement:

This position is eligible for remote work in New York.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in an office environment

  • Must be able to communicate in an effective manner to perform job duties

  • Vision must be good or corrected in order to perform essential job duties

  • Hearing must be good or corrected in order to have the ability to understand information to perform essential job duties

  • Ability to read and write in English in order to process paperwork and follow up on any actions necessary

  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as calculators, copy machines, computers, and office equipment

DOE

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: Freelance Presentation Designer
jobs.excerpt: Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases.
jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Senior Tax Analyst

Songtradr US

VACANCY: FULL-TIME

Company Profile

Songtradr is the world’s largest B2B music technology company, offering end-to-end music licensing, rights management, and direct-to-fan solutions. Through strategic acquisitions like MassiveMusic and Bandcamp, Songtradr empowers music creators and enables brands to connect with audiences through the power of music.

Learn more at.

Team

Songtradr’s tax team is part of the global Finance and Control team and operates across all business units and group entities globally, including creative solutions, music licensing solutions and consumer solutions. There is strong exposure to US and global as well as direct and indirect taxes. The team is close knit with incredible opportunities to be involved in business and tax projects to build your tax and commercial skills. Ideal for someone who wants broad tax experience with autonomy, empowerment and on-the-job learning and development from keen mentors.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Tax Accountant with expert quantitative and analytical skills to interpret, organize, and report financial data, identify business issues and opportunities, and deliver sustainable solutions. The ideal candidate manages multiple overlapping deadlines, communicates effectively across all levels of the organization, and upholds professional accounting standards and regulatory requirements at all times. Strong English communication skills, proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint), and the ability to work collaboratively and stay effective under pressure are essential. This person also brings strong project planning abilities, strategic decision-making, critical thinking, and business acumen to support long-term organizational goals, while consistently adhering to company policies on attendance, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.

Main Job Duties

  • Partner with outside tax providers, as needed, including oversight of global corporate income tax filings, including review of draft returns, tax calendars, and work plans, etc. (Jurisdictions include US, UK, NL, AU, DE, etc)
  • Oversee indirect tax compliance functions, including sales tax, Canadian GST/QST, VAT, 1099, 1042, DAC 7, and W-8 BEN-E.
  • Prepare and review correspondence relating to various tax issues, including Sales Tax audits.
  • Assist accounting with the review of routine intercompany calculations and journal entries for the region.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain data, reports, invoices, or other documentation as required.
  • Coordinate with accounting groups to ensure tax payments are allocated correctly; process journal entries or reclass entries as required.
  • Reconcile tax payments to ensure accuracy and proper allocation to internal accounts.
  • Research, analyze, interpret, document, and apply tax rules related to the sale of digital assets/services and the applicability of marketplace facilitator rules.
  • Continuously pursue professional education, updates, best practice information, and professional publications, and mentoring relationships to remain abreast of tax law developments that will impact the organization.
  • Work collaboratively with others within and outside of the Global Tax function to achieve goals, simplify processes, reduce costs, prevent loss, and to ensure that work is completed accurately and on time.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Expert quantitative analysis skills, including the ability to interpret, analyze, organize, and report financial data.
  • Demonstrate capacity for gathering and scrutinizing data to identify issues, opportunities, patterns, and sustainable business solutions.
  • Ability to meet multiple, potentially overlapping, deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively throughout the organization, including management, co-workers, and stores.
  • Demonstrated commitment to regulatory requirements; adheres consistently to all professional accounting standards and practices.
  • Proficient ability to communicate effectively with others using spoken and written English.
  • Proficient ability to remain effective under stress and respond to pressure in a manner acceptable to others and to the organization.
  • Proficient knowledge of Windows-based business computers and Microsoft Office programs; specifically, Excel, PowerBI, and PowerPoint
  • Expert project planning skills, including the ability to organize, prioritize and control job responsibilities in order to meet deadlines in an environment with overlapping and potentially conflicting priorities.
  • Consistently demonstrates a commitment to policies and procedures, including but not limited to, attendance, confidentiality, conflict of interest, and ethical responsibilities.

RELATED COMPETENCIES

  • Building Strategic Working Relationships – Developing and using collaborative relationships both within and outside the organization to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals.
  • Strategic Decision Making – Obtains information and identifies key issues and relationships relevant to achieving a long-range goal or vision; commits to a course of action to accomplish said goal or vision after developing alternatives based on technology assessments, logical assumptions, facts, available resources, constraints, and organizational values.
  • Critical Thinking and Analysis — Examines issues and ideas to identify viable, innovative business solutions in a large variety of situations with differing assumptions, contexts, and methods.
  • Global Business Acumen — Utilizing a broad, strategic understanding of how successful organizations grow, including the interdependencies between consumer, economic, financial, and legislative influences

Our Three Core Values

Lead with Music

It’s our compass and our passion. We champion creativity by putting artists, brands and fans first, balancing artistic integrity with bold commercial ambition.

Perform as One Band

United by purpose and trust. We aim high, knowing that collaboration, community, and doing it for the right reasons drives success for everyone.

Own Your Voice

We listen deeply and speak honestly. We value time, welcome diverse perspectives, and keep the rhythm of open, transparent communication alive.

Employment

Full time. What do you get in return? Inspiration, knowledge, career development, on top of our financial package. You’ll also be working with an international bunch of remarkable musically-infused individuals.

The Role

As a Senior Data Engineer (B2B), you will own the development, maintenance, and evolution of data pipelines supporting Wpromote’s B2B clients and capabilities. You will work across client teams, Data Engineering, and Product to translate complex B2B marketing and business requirements into reliable, scalable data solutions.

This role will spend approximately 75–85% of its time supporting B2B client data needs, with the remaining time focused on improving and standardizing our broader B2B data capabilities.

You will own B2B data pipelines end-to-end, including implementing approved modifications to downstream pipelines and data models when necessary to meet client requirements. This role also owns the data layer for measurement and scoring programs. Measurement methodology and analysis design are owned by strategy and analytics partners, with this role building the datasets, pipelines, and validation tooling that support them. You will be expected to understand how changes flow through the broader data ecosystem, evaluate their impact, and implement solutions that preserve data quality and maintainability.

As you identify common requirements across B2B clients, you will help turn those patterns into standardized models, reusable components, and scalable B2B data capabilities that reduce repeated custom development.

Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

  • Owning the design, development, deployment, and ongoing support of data pipelines for Wpromote’s B2B clients using BigQuery, dbt, Python, and orchestration frameworks.

  • Partnering with client teams and technical stakeholders to translate B2B marketing, sales, measurement, and reporting requirements into reliable data solutions.

  • Managing client-specific requirements throughout the data lifecycle, including making approved modifications to downstream pipelines, transformations, and data models when required.

  • Integrating and normalizing data across the B2B technology ecosystem, including CRM, marketing automation, ABM and intent, attribution, enrichment, sales engagement, paid media, web analytics, and first-party product usage and telemetry data.

  • Building data models that connect anonymous and known engagement, leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, opportunities, marketing touchpoints, and sales activity to support account-level measurement from initial engagement through pipeline and revenue.

  • Understanding upstream and downstream dependencies, troubleshooting complex production issues, and ensuring changes maintain data quality, reliability, and scalability.

  • Strengthening data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and observability.

  • Identifying recurring requirements across B2B clients and converting them into reusable models, frameworks, and configuration-driven solutions.

  • Contributing to Wpromote’s standard B2B data architecture, including common approaches to account resolution, lifecycle stages, funnel definitions, and marketing-to-revenue measurement while maintaining flexibility for client-specific requirements.

  • Using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing, documentation, and codebase exploration while maintaining accountability for production code.

  • Building activation pipelines that push data back out to operational systems, including syncing account segments, scores, and lifecycle stages to ad platforms, writing enriched data and tasks back to CRM, and keeping platform audiences current with warehouse state.

  • Investigating and validating the behavior of third-party and vendor data feeds, including delivery cadence, restatement, retention, and schema semantics, and designing pipelines that remain correct when feeds behave differently than documented.

  • Building analytical datasets that support scoring model calibration and validation, such as regression inputs from CRM history, holdout construction, lift analysis, and feedback loops from sales dispositioning.

You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field, with experience independently owning production data pipelines and data models.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and BigQuery, along with intermediate to advanced programming skills in Python.

  • Hands-on data engineering or analytics experience with CRM and at least two other areas of the B2B technology ecosystem, such as marketing automation, ABM/intent, attribution, or paid media platforms.

  • Strong understanding of B2B data models and customer journeys, including lead/contact-to-account relationships, lifecycle and funnel stages, opportunity and pipeline data, campaign membership, marketing touchpoints, and the challenges of connecting marketing activity to revenue.

  • Experience integrating data across multiple B2B systems and reconciling differences in identifiers, entities, lifecycle definitions, business processes, and data structures.

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, including the ability to navigate ambiguous client requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and communicate solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience within an advertising agency, consulting organization, or other multi-client environment.

  • Experience with lead-to-account matching and identity resolution, including reconciling person-level and account-level data across systems.

  • Experience reconstructing historical state from CRM and marketing data, such as lifecycle and opportunity stage history, snapshot-based feeds, and changes in account ownership or campaign membership over time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with platforms across the B2B ecosystem, including:

  • CRM & Sales: Salesforce Sales Cloud, HubSpot

  • Marketing Automation: Marketo, Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), Eloqua

  • ABM & Intent: 6sense, Demandbase

  • B2B Measurement & Attribution: Octane11, Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible)

  • Data Enrichment & Prospecting: ZoomInfo

  • Sales & Conversational Engagement: Salesloft, Qualified, Drift

  • Content & Buyer Engagement: PathFactory

  • Experience with multi-touch attribution and sourced/influenced pipeline measurement, including per-opportunity attribution models and credit window logic.

  • Experience building B2B measurement models that connect marketing activity and media investment to account engagement, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.

  • Experience working with historical CRM and marketing data, including changes in lifecycle status, opportunity stages, campaign membership, account ownership, and other business events over time.

  • Experience building reusable or configuration-driven data pipelines that support multiple clients while allowing controlled client-specific customization.

  • Experience with data observability, lineage, metadata management, or data quality platforms.

  • Familiarity with orchestration technologies such as Airflow, Dagster, AWS Glue, or Azure Data Factory, along with modern software engineering practices including Git, code review, CI/CD, and testing.

  • Experience with audience syndication and reverse ETL patterns, including platform audience APIs (DSP, LinkedIn, Meta) or tools such as Hightouch or Census.

  • Experience managing BigQuery cost and performance across multiple clients, including partitioning, clustering, and query cost discipline.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools, with the engineering judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated solutions.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role will center around three areas:

    Client Ownership: You will become a trusted technical owner for Wpromote’s B2B data pipelines, independently translating complex client requirements into reliable solutions and confidently managing changes across upstream and downstream systems.

    Quality: You will improve the reliability of our B2B data through stronger testing, validation, monitoring, documentation, and observability, while proactively identifying and addressing recurring data issues.

    Scale: You will recognize common patterns across B2B clients and help turn them into standardized, reusable capabilities, reducing repeated custom development while preserving the flexibility needed to support meaningful client-specific requirements.

As a key member of the Biotech Account Management leadership team, this individual partners closely with Commercial, Business Unit, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Strategy leaders to align customer growth initiatives, resource allocation, and business priorities across the region.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: NDIS Admin & Compliance Coordinator

Compensation range: $1,500 AUD - $2,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with AEST business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a growing Australian disability services provider supporting children, young people, and adults through NDIS-funded services. They deliver a range of disability supports focused on independence, capacity building, social participation, and quality of life. As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a highly capable operations professional who can bring structure to their administration, compliance, people processes, payroll, and internal systems. This is an important role within a small team, where the right person will have significant ownership and the opportunity to make a genuine operational impact.

Role Overview: Our growing NDIS organization is seeking a highly organized and strategic professional to step into the role of Internal Systems and Administration Lead. In this pivotal position, you will serve as our in-house expert, optimizing our operational frameworks and driving administrative excellence as we scale.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining -

  • NDIS Administration
  • NDIS Compliance
  • HR administration
  • Payroll coordination ( SCHADS Award )
  • Bookkeeping
  • Rostering
  • Executive support
  • Systems management

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of keeping the business organised, compliant, and running smoothly behind the scenes.

The ideal candidate is more than an administrator. You are someone who anticipates what needs to be done, identifies problems before they become issues, improves processes, and takes ownership from start to finish. You should be comfortable stepping into a fast-moving environment, figuring things out independently, and taking work off leadership's plate without needing to be constantly directed.

The Attitude & Approach We Need (The "Must-Haves")

  • Proactive Leadership & Anticipation: You excel at anticipating the needs of executive leadership and proactively identifying areas where you can add value. Rather than waiting for direction, you confidently take ownership of workflows, identify gaps before they become issues, and seamlessly take the reins to relieve pressure from the Founder/CEO.
  • High Emotional Intelligence & Discretion: Operating within the NDIS sector requires a high degree of empathy, confidentiality, and tact. You possess exceptional communication skills, easily balancing a warm, person-cantered approach with strong operational efficiency.
  • Outcome-Focused & Adaptable: We value results over micromanagement. You are highly motivated by seeing projects through to successful completion. While we deeply respect your time and work-life balance, thriving in our rapidly growing business requires flexibility and a shared commitment to going the extra mile when critical, time-sensitive tasks arise.
  • Resourceful & Autonomous: You thrive in an environment of trust and autonomy. As a highly organized self-starter, you possess strong problem-solving skills and the resourcefulness to navigate challenges independently. You are comfortable taking the initiative to research solutions, overcome roadblocks, and simply "figure it out."

Key Responsibilities:

  • Executive Support & Administration: Act as the primary EA to the Founder/CEO and Program Director.
  • Internal Systems Mastery: Set up, integrate, and seamlessly manage workflows across ShiftCare, Employment Hero, Xero, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams), Canva, and Snap forms.
  • Process Improvement & AI: Continuously identify opportunities to streamline processes, automate manual data entry, and implement practical AI/tech tools to improve business efficiency.
  • HR & Payroll Coordination: Manage employee onboarding, HR administration, personnel records, timesheets, and rostering. Apply a strong understanding of the SCHADS Award to ensure payroll accuracy.
  • NDIS Administration & Compliance: Oversee PRODA, claims, worker screening, incident reporting, restrictive practices, and audit documentation.
  • Bookkeeping: Handle routine financial tasks including Xero management, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and payroll-related finance duties. Must have experience in understanding the NDIS Price Guide, and communicating with self-managed, plan-managed, and agency-managed funding.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Extensive NDIS & PRODA Expertise: A minimum of 3 years of full-time experience navigating NDIS administration, compliance frameworks, and the PRODA portal.
  • Executive-Level Support: Proven experience as a Senior Administrator or Executive Assistant, with a strong background in supporting founders, small business owners, or leadership teams.
  • Advanced Systems Configuration: High-level proficiency in ShiftCare, Employment Hero, and Xero. You must not only know how to use these platforms but also have experience in their backend setup, configuration, and optimization.
  • Australian HR & SCHADS Award Knowledge: A strong, practical understanding of Australian HR and payroll principles, with specific expertise in interpreting and applying the SCHADS Award.
  • Core Bookkeeping Capabilities: Hands-on financial administration experience, including accurate payroll processing, invoicing, and bank reconciliations.
  • Technological Agility & Process Optimization: You are highly tech-savvy and a rapid learner of new tools (e.g., Snap forms). You possess a proven track record of streamlining workflows, implementing automations, and leveraging AI tools to drive business efficiency.
  • Comprehensive Software Expertise: Advanced skills across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) as well as practical design experience using Canva for professional communications.
  • Exceptional Communication & Accuracy: Flawless written and spoken English, paired with meticulous attention to detail across all data entry, compliance, and communication tasks.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • NDIS Compliance Screening: You must successfully undergo and maintain all mandatory background checks and worker screening required for NDIS compliance.
  • Secure Remote Setup: You must have a reliable, high-speed internet connection and your own secure, professional-grade equipment (including a modern laptop and smartphone) to perform your duties safely and effectively.
  • Full Exclusivity (40 hours/week): We require a candidate who is fully dedicated to this role on a full-time basis (40 hours per week). You must not be employed by another company, manage outside client work, or hold other ongoing commitments that would distract from this position.
  • Strict Confidentiality & No Social Media Disclosure: You must maintain absolute confidentiality regarding the business and our participants. Additionally, you must not disclose, list, or reflect this role or engagement on LinkedIn or any other public social media platforms.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Appointment Setter & Inside Sales Representative (Automotive)

Compensation range: $1,100 AUD / Monthly base + uncapped commission (~$2,300 AUD/month on target, $3,800+ AUD/month as accounts grow)

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, Perth/Manila time. Core calling hours are 1:00 PM – 6:00 PM Perth time. The remainder of the shift covers follow-ups, callbacks and confirmations. These are set hours — not flexible.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The client is an Australian performance marketing agency specialising in the automotive services sector. They work with a portfolio of small business owners, primarily detailing and paint protection shops across Australia helping them generate high-quality inbound leads through paid social advertising. Their model is results-driven and fast-paced, and their clients are hands-on trade operators who need a confident, skilled closer to convert the leads being generated into booked, paid jobs.

Role Overview: We are seeking a warm, energetic, and coachable Appointment Setter and Inside Sales Representative to be the first human voice every inbound lead speaks to. This is a full-time role from day one — you will work from a proven script and flow, calling new leads the moment they come in, booking them into client calendars, taking deposits where possible, and keeping no-show rates low through consistent follow-up and confirmation.

Speed and warmth are the whole game. The single most important metric in this role is how fast you call a new lead. You will start on one client account and pick up more as the business grows — with a clear path to becoming the lead setter across the agency's full client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Call and text inbound leads immediately upon receipt — calling within minutes is the number one performance metric
  • Work from a proven script and conversation flow while sounding natural and building genuine rapport
  • Book qualified leads into the client's calendar
  • Take deposits over the phone where possible
  • Confirm upcoming appointments to minimise no-shows
  • Handle callbacks and follow-ups throughout the shift
  • Log every call, outcome and note accurately in the CRM and Slack
  • Hit daily call and booking targets consistently

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven experience in phone sales, appointment setting, or a call centre environment
  • Clear, warm, and conversational spoken English — Australian customers must find you easy and natural to talk to
  • Genuinely coachable — daily huddles and role-plays are part of onboarding and we want someone who takes feedback and adjusts immediately
  • High energy, a real listener, and warm by nature — not a script-reader
  • Reliable high-speed internet — minimum 50 Mbps download / 20 Mbps upload, wired connection strongly preferred, plus a backup connection (mobile hotspot or secondary line)
  • Dual monitors or an ultrawide screen, a good quality headset, and a quiet dedicated workspace
  • Available to work set Perth/Manila time hours Monday to Friday — no flexibility on core hours

Desirable

  • Automotive or car-care sales knowledge
  • Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM platform
  • A track record of taking deposits or closing sales over the phone

Tools & Systems

You will work across GoHighLevel (CRM), Slack, a power dialler, and a live performance dashboard. Hours are tracked using time-tracking software (Hubstaff or similar). The team is big on clear numbers and fast feedback — not micromanagement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Speed to lead — how fast new leads are called upon arrival
  • Appointments booked per week
  • Show rate on booked appointments
  • Deposits taken per week

Compensation Structure

  • Base: $1,100 AUD/month
  • Commission: $30 AUD per appointment booked with a deposit secured — flat rate, uncapped
  • On-target earnings: approximately $2,300 AUD/month, climbing to $3,800+ AUD/month as bookings grow and additional accounts are added
  • Paid weekly

Work Arrangement & Expectations

This is a remote role set up as an independent contractor engagement. Successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as "Independent Contractor")
