jobs.excerpt: Why EntersektFounded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks.
jobs.description:
Why Entersekt

Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.

Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.

Quality at Entersekt is a shared engineering responsibility, not a final test phase. Our Quality Engineering function provides the standards, automation and independent evidence needed to deliver confidently in a regulated environment.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical and people leader with deep expertise in software quality engineering and automation. They combine strong technical depth with the ability to influence teams that do not report directly to them, balancing engineering excellence, automation strategy, release assurance and quality leadership.

They are comfortable staying close to the code, pipelines and automation frameworks while leading engineers and providing clear quality guidance across cross-functional teams. They know how to make release risk explicit, hold a quality position under pressure, resolve issues directly with accountable peers and escalate appropriately when risks exceed agreed tolerances.

The successful candidate demonstrates strong judgement, the ability to assess risk objectively and the confidence to deliver difficult feedback constructively while maintaining strong working relationships.

The Role

The QE & Automation Lead is accountable for QE-owned assurance across Entersekt's 3DS portfolio, including the Access Control Server, associated integrations and scheme certification obligations, together with delegated areas of the shared automation framework.

This role leads the Quality Engineers assigned to the portfolio while remaining actively involved in technical execution and decision-making. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring automation effectiveness, quality visibility, release confidence and continuous improvement in testing practices across the product line.

A fundamental aspect of the role is influencing engineering teams, product teams and delivery stakeholders to continuously improve product quality while supporting the needs of a highly regulated and security critical environment.

Responsibilities

Automation and Engineering Leadership

  • Own the technical design and day-to-day health of QE-owned API, web, mobile, integration, end-to-end and regression automation frameworks.
  • Lead automation delivery across Java, Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven and Appium.
  • Remain hands-on through architecture decisions, code reviews, complex test implementation and root-cause analysis of automation failures.
  • Drive regression reliability through deterministic test data, stable setup and teardown processes, transparent quarantine rules and active flaky-test reduction.
  • Embed suitable automation suites and quality evidence into GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Progress quality gates from monitored thresholds towards enforced automated controls where appropriate.

Release Assurance and Quality Intelligence

  • Develop risk-based test strategies aligned to customer impact, architecture, regulatory obligations, scheme requirements, integration risk and production history.
  • Produce evidence-based release assessments covering testing scope, automation outcomes, open defects, coverage limitations, residual risk and release recommendations.
  • Ensure release feedback is available early enough to influence delivery decisions.
  • Maintain traceable, reproducible certification, compliance and audit evidence, including scheme certification obligations.
  • Monitor and report on regression health, risk coverage, defect escape rates, repeat incidents and automation reliability.
  • Convert root-cause findings into ongoing quality improvements and corrective test coverage.

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor and develop Quality Engineers within the 3DS portfolio.
  • Manage performance through continuous and actionable feedback.
  • Ensure development and growth discussions are ongoing and that formal reviews contain no surprises.
  • Support team capability development and capacity planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coach Development and Product teams on shift-left quality practices.
  • Reinforce developer ownership of unit, component and feature-functional testing.
  • Where ownership is not sufficiently established, actively drive improvements.
  • Partner closely with Agile Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters regarding readiness, planning and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Platform and DevOps teams on environments, test data management and observability.
  • Resolve quality concerns directly with accountable engineering and delivery stakeholders.
  • Escalate appropriately only where issues remain unresolved or exceed agreed risk tolerances.

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain an agreed quality baseline.
  • Improve test automation maturity, regression effectiveness and engineering quality practices.
  • Reduce defect escape rates, repeat incidents and unnecessary escalations.
  • Increase early engagement between QE, Development, Product and Delivery teams.
  • Drive measurable improvements to quality outcomes throughout the product lifecycle.

Skills and Experience

Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and skills:

  • 6+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership of automation frameworks or complex testing solutions.
  • Strong Java knowledge and object-oriented design expertise.
  • Significant hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven and Appium, or equivalent technologies with the ability to become effective quickly.
  • Experience designing API, web, mobile, integration and end-to-end automation solutions for distributed service-based systems.
  • Strong CI/CD and GitLab pipeline experience, including:
  • Parallelisation
  • Automated quality gates
  • Reporting and visibility
  • Failure diagnosis and troubleshooting
  • Experience treating flaky tests, test data challenges and environment stability as engineering reliability problems.
  • Strong risk management judgement and experience creating risk-based test strategies and release assessments.
  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing engineering teams.
  • Performance management, coaching and capacity planning experience.
  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted software engineering for test design, code generation, maintenance and failure analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and deliver measurable value from AI-enabled practices.
  • Advantageous
    • 3D Secure (3DS) experience.
    • EMVCo scheme certification experience.
    • Payments industry experience.
    • Experience working in regulated or security-critical environments.
    • Contract testing experience.
    • Service virtualisation experience.
    • Performance testing experience.
    • Application security testing experience.
    • JUnit 5.
    • Containers and container platforms.
    • Device farms.
    • Observability tooling.
    • Experience improving automation maturity in established, long-lived codebases with inherited test coverage.

Personality Attributes

Weighted equally with technical depth, as much of the role's success depends on influencing teams that do not report directly to the QE function.

  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Clear and effective communicator with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership.
  • Collaborative team player with a pragmatic, delivery‑focused mindset.

The Revenue Operations Associate (RevOps) is responsible for the accuracy and integrity of Purview's billing and receivables. The Revenue Operations Associate also serves as the point of contact for inbound client requests to update account details, such as name and address changes.

Beyond processing transactions, this person is expected to bring a business lens to the numbers - reviewing data for accuracy and reasonableness rather than simply passing it through, and identifying trends or opportunities worth flagging to leadership. Billing & Contract Setup

  • Process adjustments to transactions on existing accounts, including credits, corrections, and billing changes.
  • Maintain and leverage Maxio (SaaSOptics) for billing, invoicing, deferred revenue, and subscription management.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Own accounts receivable for the Purview book of business, tracking aging and following up on outstanding balances.
  • Perform collections outreach to clients with past-due accounts, balancing firmness with a client-first approach.
  • Meet defined KPIs around invoicing accuracy, days sales outstanding (DSO), and collections performance.
  • Coordinate with the HealthMark accounting team to reconcile Purview's billing and AR numbers within overall company financials as part of the month end close.

Client Account Maintenance

  • Field and process inbound client requests for account changes, such as name revisions, billing address updates, and contact changes.
  • Own responses to a billing and accounts email inbox. Triage and delegate requests to the appropriate department if necessary.
  • Ensure account records stay accurate and current across billing and CRM systems.
  • Partner with Account Management and Client Advocacy teams when account changes intersect with the broader client relationship.

Reporting & Business Analysis

  • Review billing and AR data with a business mindset - checking that numbers look reasonable and flagging anomalies rather than passing them through unchecked.
  • Analyze billing, collections, and account trends to identify opportunities for process improvement or revenue recovery.
  • Support ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from the HealthMark accounting team.

Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • We are looking for someone detail oriented, curious, and eager to learn the finance side of the business.
  • High personal accountability for the accuracy of numbers.
  • Good to great Excel skills, including comfort with formulas, pivot tables, and organizing data.
  • Strong numbers orientation and attention to detail; comfortable working with financial data day to day.
  • Ability to look at data with a business lens - spotting when something doesn't look right rather than simply processing it.
  • Analytical mindset with the curiosity to dig into trends and surface opportunities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for handling client account requests professionally.
  • Self-sufficient and organized, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and KPI-driven work.
  • Desire to improve processes and grow with the organization, not simply perform tasks.

Preferred

  • Entry-level background or coursework in accounting or finance is helpful, though not required.
  • Experience with Maxio (SaaSOptics) is a strong plus.
  • Prior exposure to billing, invoicing, collections, or accounts receivable in any capacity.
  • Experience leveraging AI to improve processes.

Why Join HealthMark Group & Purview

  • Gain hands-on, foundational experience across billing, contracts, collections, and financial reporting.
  • Work directly with the HealthMark accounting team and build cross-functional finance exposure early in your career.
  • Grow your analytical and business judgment skills in a role that goes beyond data entry.
  • Contribute to a mission-driven organization improving access to medical information and supporting better patient outcomes.
  • Join a collaborative team where curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail are valued and rewarded.

  • Working knowledge of clinical research Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems

  • Knowledge of medical terminology

  • Knowledge of ICH GCP, FDA, OHRP, OSHA and HIPAA guidelines pertaining to clinical research

  • Ability to prioritize quickly and appropriately with minimal guidance

  • Ability to work independently and function as part of a team

  • Clear and concise verbal and written communications

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director, Digital Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting

What you will do

The Associate Director, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting will guide and lead the enterprise measurement and reporting problem space for the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), helping Amgen measure, understand, and improve adoption, maturity, team health, and product artifact quality across product teams, product groups, and business functions.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Digital Product Operations, this individual contributor role will serve as a product management subject matter expert for DPOM measurement. The role will shape the strategy, standards, decision systems, dashboards, and leadership-ready insights that connect DPOM adoption to enterprise operating rhythms and measurable product management outcomes.

This leader will translate the DPOM roadmap into coherent measurement strategy, integrate quantitative and qualitative signals, guide senior cross-functional partners through trade-offs, and ensure reporting drives better decisions about where to focus coaching, enablement, investment, and operating-model improvement. In addition, this role will lead regular maturity assessments of the Digital Product Management organization to identify where progress is being made in building product management capabilities and where gaps to address remain.

Responsibilities

DPOM Measurement Strategy and Framework

  • Lead the enterprise measurement strategy for DPOM adoption, product management maturity, team health, and product artifact quality across multiple teams and organizational areas.
  • Translate Product Management Hub priorities into a coherent measurement framework, maturity model, executive reporting approach, and roadmap for continuous improvement.
  • Define the standards, dimensions, and indicators used to assess adoption, maturity, artifact quality, operating health, and realized value of product ways of working.
  • Ensure the measurement approach distinguishes activity metrics from meaningful signals of adoption, maturity, decision quality, user value, and enterprise impact.
  • Frame ambiguous measurement problems, test assumptions, and determine which signals merit investment, instrumentation, leadership attention, and operating-model change.

Dashboards, Reporting, and Decision Systems

  • Own the strategy and evolution of DPOM dashboards, scorecards, reporting mechanisms, and executive readouts for MBRs, QBRs, and other enterprise operating cadences.
  • Guide analytics, technology, reporting, and product operations partners in building scalable, trusted reporting solutions.
  • Integrate quantitative data, qualitative field insights, artifact reviews, and leadership feedback into clear findings, trends, risks, and recommendations.
  • Create leadership-ready narratives that help Product Management Hub leadership, the VP of Product Management, the CTO, technology leaders, and business leaders understand progress, barriers, and trade-offs.
  • Use reporting to surface cross-product dependencies, adoption barriers, maturity gaps, and opportunities to improve DPOM effectiveness across the enterprise.

Product Management Maturity and Artifact Quality

  • Lead the assessment approach for product management maturity across teams, including outcome orientation, roadmap quality, OKR quality, decision-making, discovery, prioritization, value measurement, and lifecycle management.
  • Identify recurring maturity gaps, anti-patterns, adoption friction, and capability needs across product teams, product groups, and business functions.
  • Partner with Digital Product Management Catalysts to incorporate field-based insights from embedded engagements and convert those insights into enterprise-level learning.
  • Translate maturity and artifact-quality findings into improved standards, playbooks, templates, training, accelerator workshops, coaching approaches, and enablement materials.

Enterprise Cadence and Continuous Improvement

  • Embed DPOM measurement and reporting into enterprise operating rhythms so adoption progress, maturity trends, risks, and learning inform decision-making at the right cadence.
  • Guide senior partners across Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, digital product leadership, technology, business, analytics, and reporting teams to align on measures, interpretation, and actions.
  • Recommend annual and quarterly focus areas for DPOM measurement, reporting, enablement, and operating-model improvement based on enterprise needs and evidence.
  • Use measurement insights to guide trade-offs about where to focus support, coaching, capability-building, product community investment, and leadership attention.
  • Build repeatable mechanisms that make DPOM measurement sustainable, scalable, and useful across multiple teams and organizational areas.

Technical, Data, AI, and Governance Fluency

  • Ensure DPOM measurement decisions are grounded in fit-for-purpose data, sound instrumentation, defensible metrics, and clear interpretation of limitations.
  • Partner with technology, data, analytics, reporting, and platform teams to address data quality, access, privacy, security, regulatory, responsible-AI, and governance considerations.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities to use AI-native workflows, generative AI, and automation to improve measurement, analysis, reporting, artifact review, and leadership-readout preparation.

Leadership, Influence, and Product Community Contribution

  • Lead complex cross-functional work through clear communication, credible product judgment, and constructive challenge without relying on direct authority.
  • Influence senior partners across product, technology, business, analytics, reporting, and enablement functions to align on measurement strategy, adoption signals, and improvement actions.
  • Coach product managers and product operations partners on measurement, maturity assessment, artifact quality, dashboard interpretation, and leadership storytelling.
  • Codify effective practices, reusable examples, and standards that strengthen product management capability and the DPOM community.
  • Contribute to product management norms and operating-model practices that reinforce outcome-centered, user-centered, data-informed product leadership.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Director, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting we seek is a product-minded enterprise measurement leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • Master’s degree and 7 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience
  • Associates degree and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • High school diploma/GED and 14 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience
  • In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 3 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product operations, digital product management, product analytics, enterprise measurement, business reporting, digital transformation, technology strategy, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a complex, high-priority product, operating-model, measurement, or transformation problem space spanning multiple teams or organizational areas.
  • Experience shaping measurement strategy, maturity models, adoption frameworks, scorecards, executive dashboards, or reporting systems for product teams, operating models, or enterprise transformation efforts.
  • Expert understanding of product management practices, including roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, product strategy, discovery, prioritization, value measurement, lifecycle management, and product operating models.
  • Ability to integrate quantitative data, qualitative insights, artifact reviews, and stakeholder perspectives into clear findings, leadership-ready narratives, and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish activity, compliance, and output measures from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, value realization, team health, and impact.
  • Experience guiding senior cross-functional partners across product, technology, business, analytics, reporting, finance, operations, compliance, and enablement teams in complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience building or guiding dashboards, reporting mechanisms, scorecards, maturity assessments, or executive readouts using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority, constructively challenge senior partners, align teams through ambiguity, and guide consequential trade-offs involving data, adoption, product maturity, and operating-model improvement.
  • Experience coaching product managers or cross-functional partners, codifying reusable practices, and contributing to product management communities, standards, playbooks, or enablement programs.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining new measurement approaches, managing dependencies across teams, and improving reporting practices over time.
  • Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
  • Familiarity with AI-native product development, generative AI workflows, responsible AI principles, and the evolving role of AI in product management and product operations preferred.

About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

Job Description

If you're the kind of recruiter who wants a seat at the table (not just a list of requisitions to fill) this could be the role for you! As a Senior Recruiter at Renaissance, you'll own complex searches across multiple areas of the business while serving as a trusted talent advisor to hiring leaders. You'll build thoughtful sourcing strategies, use data and market insights to influence decisions, and know how and when to challenge assumptions. We're looking for someone who can balance getting things done with strategic partnership—communicating proactively, navigating competing priorities, and turning recruiting complexity into clear recommendations and action.

This is an opportunity for an experienced recruiter who wants both ownership and a voice in how Talent Acquisition evolves. You'll have the autonomy to manage your work while helping us strengthen the processes, tools, and practices that support hiring across Renaissance.

We are ideally looking for someone located in the CST/EST time zones.

In this role as Senior Recruiter, you will be responsible for:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for complex and high-priority searches across multiple business functions, from intake and sourcing strategy through offer, negotiation and close.
  • Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers and senior leaders, using business context and recruiting expertise to challenge assumptions and recommend the best path forward.
  • Build proactive sourcing strategies using targeted outreach, talent mapping, passive-candidate engagement, referrals, networking, CRM campaigns, and talent communities.
  • Use recruiting data, market intelligence, and candidate feedback to diagnose challenges, identify risks, and influence hiring decisions.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with HRBPs, Compensation, Finance, TA Operations, HR Operations, and other partners to move hiring forward effectively.
  • Deliver an exceptional and consistent candidate and hiring-manager experience through proactive communication, clear expectations, and thoughtful issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant recruiting data while leveraging Greenhouse, CRM technology, AI-enabled tools, and analytics to improve effectiveness.
  • Provide concise, decision-oriented updates on pipeline health, market conditions, risks, dependencies, and recommended actions.
  • Lead or contribute to TA projects and process improvements, translating lessons learned into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Share expertise and best practices across the TA team while contributing to talent mapping, pipeline development, and other proactive talent initiatives.

Qualifications

For this role as Senior Recruiter, you should have:

  • 7+ years of progressive full-cycle recruiting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated success owning complex searches across multiple business functions and partnering with senior-level hiring leaders
  • Experience operating successfully in a fast-changing or evolving organization; experience in private equity-backed, high-growth, or acquisitive environments is a plus
  • Strong sourcing, assessment, interviewing, offer negotiation, and closing skills
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and appropriately challenge stakeholders without direct authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise, decision-oriented updates
  • Experience using recruiting data and market insights to guide recommendations and hiring decisions
  • Strong ATS and recruiting-technology proficiency; Greenhouse experience is strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a changing, fully remote environment
  • Strong understanding of recruiting compliance, data integrity, and candidate confidentiality

Bonus Points:

  • Experience recruiting for SaaS, education technology, sales, customer success, product, engineering, or senior corporate functions
  • Experience with workforce planning, talent intelligence, pipeline forecasting, recruiting dashboards, or quality-of-hire insights

jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

The Director, Governance owns the foundational infrastructure every other GRC pillar depends on. Without a policy library, Compliance has nothing to test. Without regulatory horizon scanning, risk finds Riot before Riot finds risk. Without a contracts management program, vendor and third-party risk runs unchecked. Governance is the bedrock of this program — and this role builds it from near zero in Year 1.

This pillar is intentionally scoped to govern, not to test or audit. Governance owns the full lifecycle of policies and standards: drafting, approval routing, versioning, publication, and attestation tracking. Governance owns the ISO 27001:2022 documentation framework — all mandatory policy and procedure documents required for certification. Governance owns the regulatory radar, the Contracts Management program (in co-ownership with Legal), and the Third-Party Risk Management program (in partnership with Procurement).

You will report to the Senior Director, GRC and maintain a co-ownership relationship with the Chief Legal Officer on Contracts Management, where Legal holds final sign-off authority at every material decision gate. In critical operations, you will engage mining site and data center leadership to ensure site-level operational policies, physical security standards, and environmental procedures are captured within the enterprise governance framework.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the ISO 27001:2022 documentation framework: identify and produce all mandatory policies, procedures, and records required for certification, map them to Annex A controls, and drive adoption through executive sponsorship and attestation programs — this is the Year 1 priority with a contractually fixed delivery timeline.
  • Build and operate the Riot policy and standards library from near-zero baseline: establish the governance model (drafting, review routing, approval gates, versioning, renewal cadences), and extend scope beyond ISO 27001 to cover SOC 2, SOX, and enterprise policy requirements.
  • Own the regulatory horizon scanning program: monitor developments across critical infrastructure, digital assets, data privacy, and financial services; translate regulatory signals into GRC program actions; and deliver regular briefings to the Sr. Director and executive leadership.
  • Stand up the Contracts Management program in co-ownership with Legal: design the intake-to-repository workflow, establish GRC risk flagging criteria (data processing, liability, security, regulatory), and implement the Legal sign-off gate — Legal approves, GRC operates.
  • Own the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and vendor risk program: build the vendor tiering model, define due diligence requirements by tier, partner with Procurement on intake integration, and establish ongoing monitoring cadences for critical and colocation vendors.
  • Manage the GRC framework lifecycle: maintain Riot's mapping of policies and controls to SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and applicable regulatory frameworks — keeping the library current as the regulatory and audit environment evolves.
  • Engage critical operations to ensure site-level operational policies, physical security standards, and environmental procedures are captured within the governance framework and aligned to enterprise GRC standards.

What you'll bring

  • 8–12+ years of progressive GRC, policy management, regulatory affairs, or governance program experience at a publicly traded or highly regulated company.
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer certification — required. The Director, Governance is the primary owner of ISO 27001:2022 policy and documentation implementation. Riot has an active, contractually required certification obligation; this credential is a baseline requirement, not a differentiator.
  • Demonstrated experience building a policy library from a minimal baseline — governance model design, framework mapping, attestation program rollout, and cross-functional adoption.
  • Experience standing up or operating a Contracts Management program with Legal co-ownership — contract risk review, DPA requirements, and GRC-Legal governance models.
  • Working knowledge of TPRM frameworks and vendor risk program design — tiering models, due diligence questionnaires, and ongoing monitoring processes.
  • Proven regulatory horizon scanning capability across critical infrastructure, digital assets, and data privacy (CISA, FinCEN, state privacy laws, DORA, NIS2 familiarity).
  • Experience mapping a policy library to multiple frameworks simultaneously (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) to support a unified audit and control program.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and influence: ability to drive policy adoption and contracts governance across Legal, Procurement, HR, and Operations without direct authority.
  • Preferred: CISM, CGEIT, CRISC, or CIPP/US certification; experience in critical infrastructure, energy, data center, or digital asset environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Strategic Solutions Architect is the builder behind Sales Engineering's demo experience. You'll develop deep, cross-platform expertise in how Alkami's demo tooling works today — across every product line — then partner directly with Sales Engineers and Sales Leadership to understand where it's falling short and where the opportunity is. From there, you own it: designing, building, and maintaining what that tooling should look like tomorrow, front end and back end.
This is a builder and strategic-thinker role, not a release-management seat. Day-to-day demo environment operations are already supported by another role; your mandate is to implement & build and own the next generation of the tooling itself. AI will be central to how you work — you'll use AI-assisted development to build and iterate quickly, and you should already be genuinely fluent with AI tools, not just aware of them.
The role is primarily behind the scenes, but not exclusively. When a deal calls for it — a prospect wants to dig into MANTL's API, Alkami's SDK, or a complex integration — you'll step in directly and go toe-to-toe with technical leaders at the financial institution. That combination of deep builder and credible technical voice in the room is what makes this role valuable.
If you want to make a direct, visible impact on Alkami's win rate — primarily by owning the tools that make every SE's job easier, and occasionally by being the technical closer a deal needs — this is that role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Build deep, cross-platform expertise in Alkami's demo tooling — how it works today across every product line, front end and back end

  • Partner directly with Sales Engineers and sales leadership to surface pain points, gaps, and goals for improving or rebuilding demo tooling

  • Design, build, and maintain the next generation of demo tooling that closes those gaps, using AI-assisted development to move quickly

  • Step into active deals when a prospect needs deep technical depth — going toe-to-toe with technical leaders at financial institutions on MANTL's API, Alkami's SDK, or complex integrations to remove technical blockers

  • Serve as the SE org's go-to technical resource for demo tooling questions and complex configuration or capability problems

  • Identify product limitations, design pragmatic workarounds, and feed field signal back into long-term platform strategy

  • Coach and upskill Sales Engineers on technical positioning and objection handling grounded in what the tooling can and can't do

  • Quantify this role's contribution to win rate by tracking outcomes and reporting where recurring technical gaps warrant permanent product investment

  • Model and champion AI-assisted development workflows across the SE org, consistent with the team's automation standards

Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience

6–10 years in solutions engineering or software development roles, with demonstrated hands-on experience building tools, prototypes, or internal platforms against APIs, SDKs, or extensibility frameworks, and comfort operating in customer-facing or pre-sales settings when needed.

Education Level

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on proficiency in one or more modern languages (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) sufficient to build and ship both front-end and back-end tooling independently

  • Deep working knowledge of API and SDK design, authentication, and extensibility frameworks, with the ability to speak to it credibly and in depth with highly technical audiences

  • Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows, with a track record of using them to build and iterate faster

  • Working proficiency in SQL and relational databases, able to construct and troubleshoot complex queries

  • Ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into a coherent technical roadmap

  • Strong presentation and consultative skills in front of senior technical stakeholders, including the ability to hold your own with technical leaders (engineering, IT) at financial institutions

  • Ability to independently evaluate an existing technical stack or toolset across multiple products and make build, buy, or improve recommendations

  • Comfort stepping into an active deal on short notice to answer deep technical questions on APIs, SDKs, or integrations, then stepping back out

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to escalate and prioritize technical gaps surfaced from the field

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value narratives

Preferred

  • Experience in digital banking or financial services platforms

  • Direct experience building on an SDK or extensibility framework

  • Experience building internal tools or platforms used by other teams, rather than only customer-facing product

  • Track record standing up net-new tooling or infrastructure from scratch (a “0-to-1” builder background)

  • Exposure to competitive analysis and solution positioning strategies

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Security
jobs.excerpt: About Workstreet At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs.
jobs.description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to Know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our team spans three core functions: Cloud Security Engineering, where we design hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, write Terraform baselines, and fix failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP; Penetration Testing, where we run disciplined offensive assessments across networks, apps, cloud, and AI/LLM systems to catch vulnerabilities before adversaries do; and Vulnerability Management, where we continuously prioritize, patch, and validate risk reduction across the client footprint. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption.

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers and assessors are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here.

The Opportunity

Workstreet is seeking a Senior Engineer, Cloud Security who is a builder at heart with deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure engineering, with a strong emphasis on Azure and multi-cloud architectures. This is a hands-on, high-impact engineering role focused on designing and deploying security infrastructure, building hardened landing zones, automating identity lifecycles, and authoring reusable Terraform modules rather than performing audit assessments.

The successful candidate will integrate rapidly into client environments, taking direct ownership of cloud security engineering tasks, vulnerability remediation, and client engagements within their first 15 days. Working directly with client engineering leads during U.S. Eastern Time business hours, you will lead technical discussions, execute automated security operations, and ensure every environment achieves drift-resistant, code-defined security excellence.

What You'll Do

  • Engineer security via Infrastructure as Code - design and maintain reusable Terraform and CloudFormation modules for IAM, networking, and logging to build drift-resistant cloud environments.
  • Build enterprise cloud architectures - deploy and manage AWS multi-account structures including Organizations and SCPs, alongside Azure Hub-Spoke and Landing Zone architectures.
  • Architect identity and access management - implement least-privilege IAM using RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, JIT or PIM automation, and federated identity via Okta or Entra ID.
  • Execute direct vulnerability remediation - remediate cloud misconfigurations through active engineering changes, automated patching, and configuration drift correction.
  • Automate security operations and pipelines - build automated remediation workflows using Lambda, Azure Functions, and Python, integrating SAST, DAST, and secret scanning into GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Configure native cloud security stacks - deploy and tune AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, Azure Sentinel, and Defender for Cloud to build native logging pipelines for SIEM ingestion.
  • Manage network and encryption engineering - design VPCs, security groups, network segmentation, WAFs, and full-lifecycle encryption using AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault.
  • Implement technical NIST 800-53 controls - translate NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, and CMMC compliance criteria into hands-on technical controls across cloud environments.
  • Drive client-facing technical ownership - interface directly with client engineering teams, lead architectural workshops, and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

Who You Are

  • Hands-on security builder - proven track record of deploying security infrastructure, writing OPA policies, and managing secrets in Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Cloud-native technical specialist - deep expertise in Azure and AWS nuances, capable of distinguishing compliance maps from functional technical controls.
  • Infrastructure as Code expert - proficient in Terraform, with demonstrated expertise in module versioning, state management, and provider security controls.
  • Identity and access authority - deep technical understanding of SAML, OIDC, cross-account IAM roles, and enforcing least privilege without disrupting developer workflows.
  • Articulate technical communicator with a strong verbal presence, able to lead technical workshops and clearly explain complex architecture to engineering teams.
  • Multi-account portfolio operator - thrives in fast-paced startup environments, balancing multiple client priorities and executing rapid remediation without perfect documentation.

What will help you succeed

  • Active cloud security credentials - hold technical certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or GCP Professional Security Engineer.
  • FIPS 140 encryption implementation: practical experience configuring and enforcing FIPS 140 standards across cloud services.
  • Federal enclave build experience - hands-on history building CMMC-compliant enclaves or FedRAMP security architectures.
  • Container runtime security mastery - experience implementing runtime security controls and vulnerability scanning across containerized environments.

What We Offer

  • Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
  • Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
  • Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
  • Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
  • A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
  • Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET) to effectively support hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional teams. Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time-sensitive hiring needs.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.

Hiring and Selection Process

  • Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
  • Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
  • Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Workstreet does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship or transfers for this role, including H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1 (OPT/CPT), J-1, or any other work-authorized visa category.

Workstreet Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal opportunity employer, Workstreet is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Workstreet will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. jobs.excerpt: About the roleYou'll own a set of named accounts and prospect into them full time.
jobs.description:
About the role

You'll own a set of named accounts and prospect into them full time. That starts with research: what security tools an account runs, what's changed recently, where they're likely feeling pain. From there you write outreach specific enough that the person on the other end can tell you did the work.

You'll get real support doing this. AI-augmented research tools to speed up account prep, a coaching system that reviews your emails before they go out, Nooks for power dialing, and a messaging framework based on how enterprise security teams actually talk, not a generic sequence library. That said, none of it replaces the work. We're looking for someone hungry, who shows up wanting to outwork the rep at the next desk and treats a "no" as a reason to try a different angle, not a reason to slow down.

What you'll do

  • Learn the space. You'll pick up real fluency in SIEM modernization, detection engineering, and the data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) that security teams run on. You don't need a technical background coming in, but you'll need to keep up in a conversation with someone who has one.
  • Run outbound into named accounts. No spray and pray. You'll work a defined territory, research each account's environment and recent trigger events, and tailor your outreach accordingly.
  • Write emails people actually read. Every draft gets reviewed before it ships. You'll learn to lead with outcomes and write to a person instead of a title.
  • Build pipeline. Mix of outbound prospecting and inbound follow-up. You'll use intent data, CRM signals, and your own research to figure out which accounts to prioritize, and you'll know exactly where your numbers stand at any point in the quarter.
  • Get coached, and use it. Feedback here comes with the reasoning behind it, not just a correction. Reps who take this seriously tend to leave with sharper writing, positioning, and selling skills than most SDR seats teach.

Who does well here

  • Grit. You'll hear a lot of "not right now." The reps who do well treat that as information and keep working the account instead of taking it personally.
  • Self-starter. You'll own your territory and your account plans. If you need someone checking in on you daily, this isn't the right seat.
  • Coachable. Grit without coachability is just stubbornness. The best people on this team ask why, then apply the feedback the same day.
  • Curious about the tech. You don't need a security background. But if a prospect mentions a SIEM or detection engineering and you actually want to know what that means, you'll fit in well here.
  • Some sales experience. 1 to 2 years as an SDR, BDR, or similar customer-facing role, ideally at a growth-stage company or in cybersecurity or enterprise tech. You've made calls, run sequences, and know what a real pipeline number looks like.

Why Anvilogic

Anvilogic is the Agentic SecOps platform. It helps security teams onboard their data, search across it, deploy detections, and run investigations on the infrastructure they already have, without ripping anything out. We're backed by Point72 Ventures and Foundation Capital, and closed a $45M Series C.

We built our own SDR program instead of buying an off-the-shelf playbook: real voice standards, AI-augmented research, and coaching built into the day-to-day workflow. You come out having learned a methodology, not a script you'll forget in a year.

Most security teams you'll talk to are dealing with rising SIEM costs and detection coverage that hasn't kept up with their data. That's a real problem, and you'll be walking in with something that actually addresses it.

Anvilogic was founded in 2019 by security veterans and data scientists from Fortune 500 companies, and that practitioner mindset shows up on the SDR floor too. The manager running this team was an SDR here before being promoted into the role, so there's real growth opportunity for people who put in the work. Day to day, it's also a good group to work with: people who take the job seriously but don't take themselves too seriously.

Anvilogic is a Palo Alto-based cybersecurity company founded in 2019 by security veterans and data scientists from Fortune 500 companies. Our mission: help every SOC team detect threats at the level of the best, regardless of which data platform they run.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in an SDR, BDR, or similar customer-facing sales role
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and sales engagement platforms
  • Strong written communication
  • US-based
  • Curiosity about cybersecurity and enterprise technology

Benefits

  • Equity in a high-growth, Series C cybersecurity company
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Monthly stipend for home internet and cell phone
  • Growth opportunities for top performers, including paths into an AE role

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Employer Engagement & Partnerships Lead schlägst du eine Brücke zwischen den Malengo-Abiturient*innen und dem deutschen Arbeitsmarkt, wobei dein Schwerpunkt auf der Vermittlung von Ausbildungsplätzen liegt.

Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, Ausbildungsplätze insbesondere im Gesundheitswesen zu sichern und gleichzeitig Ausbildungswege in die Bereiche Logistik, Reinigung, Gastronomie, Ingenieurswesen und Betriebswirtschaft zu erschließen. In Gesprächen mit relevanten Arbeitgeber*innen identifizierst du gegebenenfalls Praktikumsmöglichkeiten und studentische Nebenjobs für unsere Hochschulstudierenden.

Deine Arbeit wird den Erfolg der Programme von Malengo direkt beeinflussen, indem du das Vertrauen der Arbeitgeber*innen stärkst, Partnerschaftsnetzwerke ausbaust und Malengo innerhalb der deutschen Berufsbildungslandschaft vertrittst.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Arbeitgeber*innenkontakt und Netzwerkentwicklung

Aufbau, Ausbau und Pflege eines starken Arbeitgeber*innennetzwerks, das Folgendes bietet:

  • Ausbildungsplätze

    • Schwerpunkt auf Gesundheitsberufe

    • Zusätzlicher Schwerpunkt auf ausbildende und zukunftsorientierte Branchen, darunter Logistik, Gastronomie, Reinigungsdienstleistungen, Technik und Nachhaltigkeit

  • Nebenjobs für Studierende (z. B. Logistik, Gastgewerbe, Reinigung) in Abstimmung mit internen Teams

  • Für Malengo-Studierende relevante Praktika, insbesondere in den Bereichen Ingenieurswesen und Betriebswirtschaft

Zu den wichtigsten Tätigkeiten gehören:

  • Vertretung von Malengo auf Jobmessen, Konferenzen, Veranstaltungen zur beruflichen Bildung und Branchenforen

  • Proaktive Identifizierung und Beziehungsaufbau mit Arbeitgeber*innen und Berufsbildungseinrichtungen durch gezielte Kontaktaufnahme, Besuche und Kontaktpflege

  • Funktion als Hauptansprechpartner*in für Arbeitgeber*innen und Berufsschulen, um Zufriedenheit, Kontinuität und langfristige Zusammenarbeit sicherzustellen

  • Stärkung der Sichtbarkeit von Malengo innerhalb des deutschen Berufsbildungssystems, einschließlich gegenüber Unternehmen und Bildungseinrichtungen.

  • Dokumentation und Berichterstattung über Partnerschaften, Vermittlungen und Ergebnisse, einschließlich Erfolgsgeschichten für interne und externe Stakeholder.

  • Aushandlung und Formalisierung von Kooperationsvereinbarungen mit Arbeitgeber*innen, Berufsschulen und Ausbildungsanbieter*innen.

2. Programmstrategie und kontinuierliche Verbesserung

  • Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Strategien, um v.a. Ausbildungsplätze für Malengo-Abiturient*innen zu erschließen

  • Sammeln von Rückmeldungen vonseiten Arbeitgeber*innen und Abiturient*innen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Vermittlungsqualität und -prozesse

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams in Deutschland und Ostafrika, um die Abstimmung zwischen den Bedürfnissen der Arbeitgeber*innen und den Profilen der Abiturient*innen sicherzustellen

  • Unterstützung der Zusammenarbeit über die Malengoprogramme hinweg durch Identifizierung und Förderung von Nebenjobs und Praktikumsmöglichkeiten für Malengostudierende

Dein Profil

  • Engagement für Malengos Ziele und den Erfolg unserer Abiturient*innen

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Recruitment, Arbeitgeber*innenbindung, Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenakquise oder einem verwandten Bereich

  • Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Aufbau von Beziehungen und in der Kommunikation, anpassungsfähig an verschiedene Interessengruppen

  • Selbstbewusstes Auftreten als Vertreter*in von Malengo: proaktiv, überzeugend und professionell

  • Ausgeprägte Organisationafähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Interessengruppen und Prioritäten zu managen

  • Masterabschluss, Bachelorabschluss oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen (ca. eine Reise pro Monat)

  • Sprachen: Deutsch (C2 / Muttersprachniveau) und Englisch (C1)

Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen

  • Interkulturelle Sensibilität und Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Migrant*innen, Flüchtlingen oder internationalen Studierenden

  • Bestehendes Netzwerk oder Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, in der beruflichen Bildung oder in Branchen mit Fachkräftemangel

  • Verständnis der Vorschriften für die Beschäftigung von Nicht-EU-Bürger*innen oder Flüchtlingen

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Ausbildungssystems oder von Programmen zur Integration von Arbeitskräften

  • Erfahrung in NGOs, Stiftungen oder im Bereich der internationalen Entwicklung

  • Kenntnisse ostafrikanischer Sprachen (z. B. Swahili oder andere regionale Sprachen) sind von Vorteil

Was wir bieten

  • Attraktives Gehalt entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung (55.000 bis 65.000 Euro pro Jahr)

  • 30 Urlaubstage und geregelter Überstundenausgleich

  • Flexible Homeofficearbeit mit regelmäßigen Teambesprechungen in Deutschland/Uganda/Kenia

  • Ein 1-Jahres-Vertrag mit der Möglichkeit, in einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag umgewandelt zu werden

  • Zusammenarbeit mit einem hochmotivierten internationalen Team

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Sichtbarkeit bei der Gestaltung von Arbeitgeber*innenpartnerschaften in Deutschland

  • Die Möglichkeit, ein junges Start-up mitzugestalten und das Leben vieler junger Menschen und ihrer Familien positiv zu beeinflussen

Bewerbungen werden fortlaufend berücksichtigt, bis die Stelle besetzt ist.

Bewerbungsunterlagen: Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben

Voraussichtlicher Arbeitsbeginn: so bald wie möglich

Malengo setzt sich für Vielfalt ein und wir glauben, dass unsere Arbeit durch unsere Unterschiede in Bezug auf Hintergrund, Kultur, Erfahrung, nationale Herkunft, Religion, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Behinderung und mehr gestärkt wird.

Malengo ist eine gemeinnützige Organisation (Deutschland: gGmbH; USA: 501(c)(3)), die internationale Bildungsmigration fördert. Wir bieten Mentoring und finanzielle Unterstützung für Abiturient*innen aus einkommensschwachen Ländern, die einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine Berufsausbildung in einem einkommensstarken Land absolvieren möchten. Unser Ziel ist es, Millionen von jungen Menschen die Möglichkeit zu geben, Ihren gewünschten Bildungsweg zu absolvieren und sich und ihre Familien dabei aus der Armut zu befreien. Wir glauben, dass dies eine der effektivsten Strategien zur Armutsbekämpfung ist, gemessen am Impact pro Dollar.

Malengo unterstützt derzeit einkommensschwache, begabte junge Menschen in Uganda bei der Bewerbung und dem Abschluss eines Bachelorstudiums in Deutschland sowie Flüchtlinge in Kenia, die eine Berufsausbildung in Deutschland absolvieren möchten. Bis 2030 wollen wir Abiturient*innen aus den meisten einkommensschwachen und einkommensschwachen Ländern unterstützen. Unser Programm ist nachhaltig, da es ein starkes Netzwerk von ehrenamtlichen Mentor*innen mit einem Finanzierungsmodell kombiniert, bei dem derzeitige Abiturient*innen zukünftige Generationen von Abiturient*innen unterstützen, sobald sie ein ausreichend hohes Einkommen erzielen (über Income Share Agreements, ISAs).

Fünf vollständige Kohorten von Malengo-Studierenden, die insgesamt aus etwa 300 jungen Menschen bestehen, sind bereits in Deutschland. Die ersten dieser Studierenden haben ihr Studium bereits abgeschlossen. Rund 50 weitere Studierende bereiten sich auf ihre Ankunft im Herbst 2026 vor.

Darüber hinaus bereiten sich rund 250 junge Menschen darauf vor, nach Deutschland zu kommen, um eine Berufsausbildung (hauptsächlich in der Krankenpflege) zu beginnen, die ersten davon im Frühjahr 2026. Diese jungen Menschen besuchen derzeit intensive Deutschkurse in Kenia und Ruanda. Die meisten von ihnen sind Flüchtlinge, hauptsächlich aus dem Südsudan, Somalia, Burundi und der Demokratischen Republik Kongo.

In Deutschland arbeitet Malengo eng mit Arbeitgeber*innen, Ausbildungsanbieter*innen und Institutionen zusammen, um Stipendiaten in Ausbildungsplätze, Praktika und Studierendenjobs zu vermitteln, insbesondere in Branchen mit akutem Fachkräftemangel wie dem Gesundheitswesen. Das Vertrauen der Arbeitgeber*innen, hochwertige Vermittlungen und nachhaltige Partnerschaften sind für Malengos Arbeit von zentraler Bedeutung.

This role serves as in the field support and phone support resource, handling a high volume of inbound technical cases from dealers, customers, and internal teams, while also delivering on‑site field assistance and training.

The position focuses on execution, responsiveness, and delivery of consistent support using established documentation, workflows, and escalation paths. While technical in nature, this role does not function as a technical authority and does not involve complex investigations, product architecture decisions, or foundational documentation.

This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, comfort operating in a high‑volume phone support environment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to travel extensively to support customers in the field.

Key Responsibilities

Field & On‑Site Support

  • Travel to customer job sites and dealer locations to support Machine Control installations, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Assist with system setup, calibration, and validation using established processes.
  • Support customers during job startup and early production phases to ensure system readiness.
  • Represent the Professional Services team in the field with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, clear communication, and effective issue resolution

Dealer & Customer Training

  • Deliver onsite and remote training using approved training materials and existing curricula.
  • Reinforce correct system operation, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with dealers and customers.
  • Support Instructor‑Led Training (ILT) events as needed.

Cross‑Functional Support

  • Work closely with Sales, Product Platform, and Professional Services teams to support deployments and customer engagements.
  • Document detailed case notes, logs, and observations to assist Senior Specialists and Engineering teams with analysis and resolution
  • Support Senior Application Specialist for engineering investigations through accurate reproduction of field issues and application details.
  • Assist Sales teams with system quotes, dealer meetings, demonstrations, and trade show events as needed.

Phone & Call‑Center Support

  • Serve as a responder for inbound phone and case‑based support, handling a high daily volume of Machine Control support cases/calls.
  • Diagnose and resolve common to intermediate technical issues using documented procedures, wiring diagrams, and configuration guides.
  • Provide real‑time troubleshooting guidance to dealers and customers over the phone, screen sharing, and remote tools.
  • Accurately document cases, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to support knowledge sharing and escalation.
  • Identify trends in recurring issues and communicate patterns to Senior Application Specialists or team leaders.
  • Escalate complex, high‑impact, or unresolved issues following defined support escalation paths.

Documentation & Process Adherence

  • Utilize existing technical documentation, wiring diagrams, setup guides, and workflows during support activities.
  • Create and provide feedback on documentation usability and field accuracy.
  • Follow established support procedures, case management standards, and communication guidelines.
  • Create detailed, high quality defect reports and technical documentation (e.g., JIRA tickets) to support efficient engineering resolution.
  • Contribute to improvement of eLearning curriculum, creating knowledge articles, quick guides, and technical training program support.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands‑on experience with Machine Control systems or related construction technology.
  • Working knowledge of GNSS systems, basic hydraulics interfaces, electrical systems, and software configuration.
  • Ability to manage multiple active cases simultaneously in a fast‑paced support setting.
  • Strong verbal communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical users.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed up to 50%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Machine Control field technician or bench technician.
  • Hands-on experience supporting MCX platforms, mmGPS/LPS. GNSS receivers, and RTK radio systems.
  • Proficiency with remote diagnostic tools, including screen sharing and virtual troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic technical wiring diagrams, voltages, hydraulics and signal flows.
  • Experience providing both phone-based technical support and on-site field deployments.
  • Practical experience operating heavy equipment and installing machine control systems on Dozers, Motor Graders, and Excavators

.

Role Expectations

  • Leverage Senior Application Specialists for advanced troubleshooting and technical investigations.
  • Operate effectively within established procedures, guidelines, and defined escalation paths.
  • Emphasis on delivering consistent, high-quality support execution rather than independent technical leadership.
  • Demonstrate reliability, professionalism, and a strong customer service mindset in both phone-based and on-site support environments.

Job Description Summary

Position Summary
The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted strategic advisor and operational partner to the Chief Executive Officer, helping maximize executive effectiveness while accelerating execution of Mosaic Health’s highest-priority strategic initiatives.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving enterprise coordination, executive operating cadence, strategic execution, transformation initiatives, and executive communications across the organization. Acting as an extension of executive leadership, the Chief of Staff ensures priorities are translated into action, cross-functional teams remain aligned, and critical initiatives are executed with discipline and urgency.

The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, private equity-backed environment and possess the judgment, business acumen, and influence required to work effectively across executive leadership, Board members, business unit leaders, and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, solving complex operational challenges, and driving flawless execution.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

What You’ll Do

Executive Office Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and operational extension of the CEO, ensuring executive focus remains on the organization’s highest-value priorities.
  • Manage executive priorities by coordinating decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely execution of follow-up actions.
  • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively resolve issues before they require executive intervention.
  • Prepare the CEO for Board meetings, sponsor interactions, customer meetings, investor discussions, and other strategic engagements.
  • Continuously improve executive workflows by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to increase productivity.

Executive Leadership Team Effectiveness

  • Own and continuously improve the Executive Leadership Team’s operating cadence.
  • Develop executive meeting agendas, pre-read materials, action logs, decision trackers, and governance processes.
  • Ensure accountability for enterprise commitments through disciplined follow-up and progress tracking.
  • Connect priorities across business units and corporate functions to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration across the executive team while promoting transparency, alignment, and shared accountability.

Strategy Execution & Enterprise Initiatives

  • Translate executive priorities into actionable workplans with defined milestones, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple business units or lack a natural organizational owner.
  • Partner with senior leaders to remove execution barriers and accelerate enterprise priorities.
  • Develop executive dashboards and progress reports that provide visibility into strategic initiatives and organizational performance.
  • Support annual strategic planning and enterprise prioritization activities.

Enterprise Transformation

  • Coordinate enterprise transformation initiatives in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Maintain executive project plans, governance documentation, milestone tracking, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Support organizational redesign, business integration, and enterprise change management initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation efforts remain aligned with Mosaic Health’s strategic objectives and value creation plan.

Executive Communications & Board Support

  • Develop polished executive presentations, Board materials, sponsor updates, and strategic communications.
  • Improve the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive messaging across internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate responses to Board members, investors, and private equity sponsors.
  • Ensure executives are equipped with high-quality materials that enable informed decision-making and effective stakeholder engagement.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, and functional teams across Mosaic Health.
  • Influence without formal authority through credibility, collaboration, and exceptional follow-through.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a connector across the organization, helping leaders navigate complex issues and align around shared priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Eight or more years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, private equity, corporate development, investment banking, healthcare operations, or a Chief of Staff role supporting senior executives.
  • Experience working directly with a CEO or executive leadership team in a complex, high-growth organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation development.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve business processes and executive productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare services, value-based care, managed care, provider organizations, or healthcare technology.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed organization.
  • Familiarity with Board governance, investor communications, and sponsor reporting.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, organizational integration, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Strong enterprise and commercial acumen.
  • Executive presence and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority.
  • Outstanding organizational discipline and follow-through.
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Resourcefulness, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.
  • High humility, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for simplifying complexity.

Success in the Role

Within the first 12 months, the successful Chief of Staff will:

  • Significantly increase executive leadership effectiveness through disciplined operating cadence and organizational alignment.
  • Improve CEO leverage by assuming responsibility for high-impact strategic and operational work.
  • Deliver Board materials, executive presentations, and strategic communications that consistently require minimal executive revision.
  • Successfully coordinate enterprise strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Strengthen accountability across executive workstreams through transparent governance and follow-through.
  • Improve cross-functional collaboration and visibility into enterprise priorities.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows that enhance executive productivity and organizational efficiency.
  • Become a trusted advisor to executive leadership, Board members, and private equity sponsors through thoughtful judgment, credibility, and flawless execution.

Mosaic Health is committed to building an inclusive workplace where talented individuals from diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe better care begins with empowered people, collaborative teams, and leaders who are passionate about improving the health of the communities we serve.

If you’re energized by solving complex problems, influencing enterprise-wide strategy, and helping shape the future of healthcare delivery, we’d love to hear from you.
