jobs.title: Director - Data Platform
jobs.excerpt: Job Description: The Director of Data Platforms is responsible for leading a function and/or collection of teams within CSI's data engineering organization in the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of secure, scalable, well-governed data platforms and pipelines across CSI's banking and fintech solutions.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Director of Data Platforms is responsible for leading a function and/or collection of teams within CSI's data engineering organization in the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of secure, scalable, well-governed data platforms and pipelines across CSI's banking and fintech solutions. This position executes the data platform technology vision and organizational plans in conformance with the company's policies and the objectives of senior management, and is responsible for the workload, outputs, and resources within the data engineering function. The Director establishes short- and long-term goals, standards, and processes that align data platform delivery with broader product, analytics, and AI strategies, leads a team of engineering managers, and champions continuous improvement and strong governance across the data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Organizational Management

  • Directs a department of data engineers, data architects, quality engineers, and other individual contributors to achieve strategic and operational goals for CSI's data platforms.
  • Inspires, coaches, and provides guidance to team members to improve performance, drive accountability, and support achievement of business objectives.
  • Partners with senior leadership on the data platform vision and strategy, helping shape the future-state data engineering organization.
  • Communicates organizational priorities, policy, and strategy clearly across the department.
  • Champions a culture of ownership, initiative, continuous improvement, and strong data stewardship.
  • Upholds all policies and procedures, company culture, and values.

Data Platform Delivery & Engineering Oversight

  • Owns the quality of data pipelines, warehouses, and platforms delivered, and the implementation of standards, methods, metrics, and procedures across the data engineering lifecycle, evaluating and refining as needed with other leaders in the organization.
  • Directs the architecture, performance, and cost management of CSI's Snowflake environment, including warehouse sizing, workload management, and credit optimization.
  • Drives a sense of urgency for platform and process improvement to meet and exceed internal and customer data requirements.
  • Applies lean principles to reduce pipeline cycle time and eliminate waste across the data development process.
  • Works with other leaders to standardize data engineering practices, including data modeling, pipeline testing, transformation standards (e.g., dbt), documentation, and reporting on overall platform performance.
  • Reviews and approves data platform releases, schema changes, and deployment plans, ensuring delivery risk is appropriately identified and managed.
  • Leads or supports root cause analysis on significant data quality incidents or pipeline failures in partnership with engineering teams and drives preventive action.

Data Governance, Classification & Audit

  • Owns and matures CSI's data governance framework, including data classification standards (e.g., confidential, PII, non-public personal information), data lineage, cataloging, and retention practices.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit teams on matters related to data platform controls, access governance, and evidence collection.
  • Partners with Compliance, Risk, and Legal to ensure data governance practices align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GLBA, SOC 2, state privacy laws) and internal policy.
  • Establishes and maintains audit trails, access reviews, and lineage documentation sufficient to support SOC 2 assessments, regulatory exams, and third-party audits.
  • Implements and enforces role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege principles across Snowflake and other data platforms.
  • Leads data quality monitoring, issue remediation, and metadata management programs to build organizational trust in reported data.

Operational Performance & Process Improvement

  • Establishes and reviews reporting and dashboards that track departmental priorities, platform reliability, data quality, and goal achievement.
  • Prepares and manages budgets for the data engineering department, including Snowflake and related platform spend, and monitors spend against plan.
  • Leads or contributes to yearly budget and headcount planning for the organization.
  • Ensures appropriate staffing levels, effective workload balance, and scalable data engineering practices across teams.
  • Uses engineering and data metrics/KPIs (e.g., pipeline reliability, data quality, query performance, cost per workload) to measure team performance and drive targeted, continuous improvement actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Works closely with product, analytics, data science/AI, and QA teams to define data platform requirements and data-related metrics.
  • Partners with security, risk, and vendor management on due diligence, audit evidence, and response to RFP or security questionnaires as needed.
  • Partners with internal and external audit teams on a recurring basis to support control testing, evidence requests, and remediation of findings.
  • Partners with infrastructure and operations teams as required and appropriate on capacity planning, hosting, and platform reliability.
  • Works effectively with all levels of leadership, including business and customer-facing stakeholders, to support delivery success.
  • Stays current on industry trends, data engineering best practices, and the broader data/analytics stack to support team readiness and capability development.
  • Partners with infrastructure and network teams to resolve technical integration challenges as acquired platforms and data sources are brought into CSI's broader data environment.

People Leadership

  • Leads, mentors, and evaluates managers, including regular 1:1s, goal setting, coaching, and performance review processes.
  • Participates in interviews and hiring decisions for data engineering leadership and key technical roles.
  • Builds high-performing teams that demonstrate accountability, adaptability, and strong employee engagement.
  • Demonstrates a track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-quality data engineering talent.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Oversees access control processes for data platforms and engineering systems, ensuring appropriate approvals and audit trails.
  • Supports initiatives to reduce reliance on shared credentials and strengthen controls around production and data access.
  • Partners with vendor management on contract review, vendor risk, and cost control for data platform vendors and tools (e.g., Snowflake, ELT/ETL tooling, data catalogs).
  • Owns SOC 2 and other audit or compliance efforts as they relate to data platforms, ensuring timely and complete evidence collection from engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including a strong technical background as an individual contributor on data platforms.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Snowflake required, including architecture, performance tuning, security model, and cost/credit management.
  • Proven experience managing managers and leading multi-layered data engineering teams in a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data governance, data classification, and metadata management practices across large teams.
  • Direct experience supporting internal and external audit engagements, including evidence collection, control testing, and remediation.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-quality data engineering teams.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present technical and business information to a wide audience including auditors, customers, peers, and staff.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills; comfortable operating with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in banking, fintech, or financial services, including regulated data environments.
  • Experience with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or similar ELT/ETL and orchestration tools) and cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with data catalog and lineage tooling (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Atlan) and classification/tagging frameworks.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to banking data (e.g., GLBA, HMDA, SOC 2).
  • Deep experience working with either Atlassian Jira or Azure DevOps to manage data engineering SDLC.
  • Experience driving change across a complex, global engineering organization.
  • Familiarity with vendor management and security or RFP response processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams are well-prepared, supported, and consistently meet delivery expectations.
  • Data platforms deliver secure, high-quality, well-governed data on predictable cadences with continually improving pipeline reliability.
  • Data classification, lineage, and access governance are consistently applied across all data assets.
  • Internal and external audits proceed smoothly, with evidence readily available and findings proactively remediated.
  • The Snowflake environment is optimized for cost, performance, and security.
  • Leadership has clear visibility into data platform priorities, progress, and performance through KPIs and dashboards.
  • CSI's data engineering organization continues to evolve toward a stronger, more resilient, and well-governed data foundation.

Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - NY Metro
jobs.excerpt: NexusTek is a national leader in managed IT, cloud, cybersecurity, and AI-powered services, trusted by organizations ranging from fast-growing mid-market businesses to large enterprises.
jobs.description:
NexusTek is a national leader in managed IT, cloud, cybersecurity, and AI-powered services, trusted by organizations ranging from fast-growing mid-market businesses to large enterprises. With a team of 300+ technology professionals operating across 40+ states and offices in Denver, Irvine, Boston, and New York City, we deliver solutions that are scalable, secure, and built for business impact.

Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help clients modernize, protect, and accelerate their business through technology. From hybrid cloud migrations and advanced cybersecurity frameworks to applied AI strategies—including our Managed Intelligence practice, which brings AI agent services from pilot to production—NexusTek empowers organizations to achieve measurable results while maintaining focus on their core priorities.

By combining national reach with personalized service, we bring the expertise, agility, and reliability needed to turn technology into a true competitive advantage. Learn more at www.nexustek.com

Working hours

  • 8:00 am – 5:00 pm local business hours
  • Occasional after-hours support as required for client needs
  • Regional travel for client meetings (approx. 25%)

Location requirements

NYC or Boston

Remote, work from home in the United States

Why this job is exciting

Are you ready to elevate your career by leading enterprise-level technology transformation? As an Enterprise Account Executive at NexusTek, you’ll engage directly with senior executives, shaping the IT strategies of some of the nation’s most dynamic organizations. You’ll drive high-value opportunities across cloud, cybersecurity, and AI—including our Managed Intelligence practice, where you’ll help clients envision and adopt AI agent solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. This isn’t a role where you hand off technical conversations to an architect and wait. You’ll be the one connecting business problems to multi-service solutions in real time, designing creative engagement strategies, and owning the vision from first meeting to signed contract. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for a technical seller who thrives on closing complex deals and building long-term enterprise partnerships.

Who you are

You are a technical seller with strong executive presence—someone who lives at the intersection of business strategy and technical possibility. You don’t wait for a solutions architect to tell you what’s possible; you already know, because you’ve spent enough time in the weeds to understand how cloud, AI, and security capabilities map to real business outcomes. You’re a natural hunter who can walk into a discovery session, hear a CFO describe margin pressure, and mentally connect that to a FinOps engagement, a Managed Intelligence pilot, or a security modernization play—without needing a pre-built playbook. You thrive in a fast-paced, competitive environment where creative problem-solving and consultative selling fuel success.

You know how to:

•Independently scope and design high-level solution frameworks during client conversations—stitching together cloud, security, and AI services into cohesive business cases without relying on pre-built playbooks.

• Drive net-new enterprise sales while expanding relationships within assigned strategic accounts.

• Conduct executive-level discovery sessions that uncover business priorities and translate them into multi-service NexusTek engagements on the spot.

• Build compelling financial business cases that clearly articulate ROI, competitive advantage, and time-to-value.

• Lead the sales cycle for multi-million-dollar deals spanning hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, and AI/ML platforms—including Managed Intelligence (AI agent services).

• Translate emerging capabilities—especially agentic AI and applied AI/ML—into concrete, client-specific use cases that resonate with C-suite buyers.

• Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and execute against a defined territory and account plan.

• Collaborate with solution architects, delivery teams, and executive leadership to ensure successful adoption—but own the technical vision in client-facing conversations.

• Expand NexusTek’s reach by building strategic channel, alliance, and referral partnerships.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of IT sales experience with a track record of exceeding quota in enterprise or mid-market accounts.

• Proven ability to close complex transactions with $1M+ TCV.

• Deep experience in consultative selling to C-suite and line-of-business leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to creatively combine services into solutions—you’ve built proposals that stitched together cloud, security, and AI into a cohesive business case, not just sold a single product line.

• Strong working knowledge across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), cybersecurity (SOC, MDR, Zero Trust, compliance-driven solutions), hybrid infrastructure (VMware, Nutanix, containerization), Microsoft 365, and networking/storage/backup/cyber recovery.

• Familiarity with generative AI, applied AI/ML platforms, and the emerging AI agent ecosystem.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling managed services or working within an MSP environment.

• Background in channel or alliance sales alongside direct enterprise selling.

• Vertical expertise in regulated industries such as life sciences, financial services, or hospitality.

• Exposure to FinOps, cloud cost optimization, or IT modernization consulting.

• Familiarity with AI governance, acceptable use policies, or AI Centers of Excellence.

Pay and Benefits:

This is a full-time position located in the United States and performed remotely with some travel.

The actual salary offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure (for existing employees) skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role.  Note that the majority of individuals in the position will fall in the low to mid-level of the scale; the upper end of this pay scale is offered only in exceptional circumstances and/or for unusually qualified candidates.

In additional to the base salary this position offers uncapped generous sales incentives based on MRR, Product, Professional Service sales.

In addition to legally-required benefits, NexusTek offers a generous benefit package to eligible full-time employees, which currently includes the following:

  • Four weeks of annual accrued PTO
  • Seven paid national holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision options
  • Company-paid life insurance, short and long-term disability
  • Voluntary benefits such as critical illness and accident
  • Voluntary Legal Shield and identity theft protection
  • Discretionary annual 401k match plan
  • Generous employee referral bonus plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Access to over 90,000+ courses in ADP My Learning
  • StandOut employee engagement tools
  • Eligible to apply for a Pluralsight license
  • Eligible to apply for NexusTek Technical Academy or Leadership Academy

We’re happy to provide our comprehensive benefits guide. Each benefit is subject to eligibility requirements as specified in plan documents, and the Company reserves the right to modify the benefits it offers from time to time.

We seek dedicated professionals who prioritize their role with us as their primary employment. Engagement in additional employment or business activities that may conflict with your responsibilities with NexusTek is not permitted.

Interview Process -Typical interview process for this role:

Application Stage -Thanks for showing interest by submitting your application!

Screening Stage -Let's get to know each other!

  • Our recruiters carefully consider each application. If you are selected to move forward, we will contact you for the 20 minute introductory screening to learn more about you and why you want to work for NexusTek.
  • As part of our interview process, we use the Culture Index Survey—a brief, 5–10-minute assessment designed to help us understand your natural work preferences and behaviors. The survey consists of two sections:
    • Self-Description: Select adjectives that best describe you.
    • Job Requirements: Choose adjectives that reflect how you believe you need to behave to succeed in your current or desired role.
    • Prior to moving to the interview phase, you will be asked to complete the survey, or you can take beforehand here:

Interview Stage -We’ll dive into your experience more in depth

  • 45 minute interview with the hiring manager - VP, Advanced Solutions Group (virtual)
  • 45 minute interview with the SVP, Cloud Consulting (virtual)
  • 30 minute conversation with CSO (virtual)
  • Face to face interview with the hiring manager (travel arrangements made per location basis)
  • Wrap up call with the CEO (virtual)
  • You are welcome to request additional conversations with team members you didn’t get to meet during the process

NexusTek provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws

NexusTek participates in E-Verify for all US Employees

Please be aware of potential recruitment fraud and fake social media pages. NexusTek will never ask you to pay a fee as part of the interview process. Additionally, we will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an employment offer and completed virtual onboarding training and paperwork provided by our HR team.

All communications with NexusTek professionals will only be sent from an @nexustek.com or ADP email address and never originate from gmail.com, yahoo.com, or other commercial email services. Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Als neues Mitglied unseres Fulfillment Teams treibst Du mit uns den Entwicklungsprozess von Softwarelösungen für die Bereiche Ticketerstellung und Versand voran. Das Fulfillment Team ist eines der drei selbstorganisierten Domainteams der ticket i/O IT, die am Online-Ticketing für Veranstaltungen arbeiten. Derzeit besteht es aus 4 Personen, darunter ein Tech Lead sowie ein Product Owner.

Insgesamt darfst Du dich auf 30 Teamkolleg:innen in der IT und dem Produktteam freuen. Neue Features sowie die Weiterentwicklung unserer Online-Ticketing Software treibst Du mit uns in Sprints voran. TypeScript (nodeJS) ist dabei unsere Programmiersprache der Wahl, als Framework vertrauen wir auf die Vorzüge von nestJS im Backend, sowie ReactJS im Frontend. Unsere Anwendung bauen und hosten wir auf AWS und schaffen so eine auf Micro-Services basierende und skalierbare Infrastruktur. Bist Du am Start?

Wer wir sind? Wir sehen uns als innovatives Unternehmen der Ticketing- und Veranstaltungsbranche. Dabei verarbeiten wir die langjährigen Erfahrungen aus Event-, Freizeit- Sport- und Messebereich mit der besten Technologie zu einer intuitiven Softwarelösung. Seit 2014 sorgen mittlerweile gut 90 Mitarbeiter:innen mit viel Engagement für einen reibungslosen Ablauf vor, während und nach einer Veranstaltung.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstütze dein Team in der ständigen Weiterentwicklung und Neu-Implementierung für das Erzeugen und Entwerten von Veranstaltungstickets sowie deren Versand
  • Konzipiere und entwickle neue Features: von der Analyse der Anforderungen bis zur Umsetzung der einzelnen Entwicklungsschritte
  • Wäge lösungsorientiert, pragmatisch und wirtschaftlich zwischen visionären Ideen und optimaler Software Architektur ab
  • Übernimm die Prozessüberwachung (Monitoring) und berücksichtige dabei besonders die Skalierbarkeit
  • Ein wenig Operation (DevOps), in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren beiden Administratoren
  • Wir arbeiten nach dem Motto “you built it, you run it”, mit Unterstützung von unserem CoreTeam als Framework vertrauen wir auf die Vorzüge von nestJS im Backend, sowie React im Frontend

Qualifikation

  • Du magst die Arbeit in agilen Teams und arbeitest selbstorganisiert und eigenverantwortlich
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Distributed Systems
  • Du kennst dich aus: vom Frontend zum Backend über die Infrastruktur hin bis zur Datenbank
  • Du besitzt mehrjährige (berufliche) Erfahrung mit Node.js und gehst sicher mit JavaScript um (idealerweise mit TypeScript)
  • Du hast einen Blick für saubere Architekturen und Schnittstellen
  • Du perfektionierst deine Arbeit mit Hilfe von UnitTests & Co. und nutzt GIT um mit deinem Team im sync zu bleiben
  • Du bist wissbegierig und hast keine Scheu, neue Programmiersprachen, Technologien und Methoden kennen zu lernen
  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und gutes Deutsch (mind. B2)
  • Erfahrung mit DDD (Domain Driven Designs) oder AWS Kenntnissen sind ein Plus

Benefits

  • Modernes Apple-Hardware, freie IDE-Auswahl, dazu zwei 4k-Bildschirme an den Arbeitsplätzen im Office
  • Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeit und Homeoffice (bis zu 100% remote), Firmenfitness (Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft) & 30 Tage Urlaub plus 2 Tage Betriebsferien
  • JobRad: Lease über uns dein neues Traummodell
  • Gute Absicherung: profitiere von betrieblich bezuschusster Berufsunfähigkeits- und Altersvorsorge
  • Eine offene und wertschätzende Atmosphäre im Arbeitsalltag und darüber hinaus - genieße mit uns einzigartige Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern und unterschiedlichste weitere Team-Aktivitäten

Neben den fachlichen Anforderungen suchen wir Menschen, die zu uns passen. Erfahrung und Menschlichkeit sind für uns das Wichtigste. Einblicke zu Arbeit und Unternehmenskultur findest Du daher auch in unserem kununu-Profil und bei instagram, schau gerne vorbei! 🙂

Lust bekommen? Stelle zusätzliche Fragen oder bewirb dich direkt inkl. Lebenslauf, Link zu deinem Github-Account, Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Startdatum z. Hd. von Viktoria.

jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada Health is a digital care provider that empowers people to achieve their health goals through sustainable behavioral change. We are on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time. We’re looking for a software engineer to join our Enrollment team — the group that owns the technology moving a prospective member from initial interest all the way through eligibility, plan selection, and activation as an enrolled participant.

Great software is the key to providing effective care at scale. We hire passionate, creative people and give them the autonomy to do great work. Our software engineers are comfortable dealing with high-level specifications, working independently and in small teams, and are heavy contributors in the product process from idea to production.

About you:

You work with empathy for your coworkers, stakeholders and users. You are excited to work cross-functionally with a variety of people and ideas. You work directly with stakeholders to design solutions and drive the technical decisions for delivery. You proactively keep up with technology trends and can assess technical trade-offs between solutions across service boundaries. You care about writing quality software and recognize that there are often many right answers. You are excited about the challenge of learning new technologies and context. You are enthusiastic about providing the best possible care for our members.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and implement a blend of proprietary and third-party tools that power our member enrollment funnel — eligibility verification, plan/benefit matching, signup, and activation. Play a pivotal role in influencing conversion and time-to-enrollment by refining existing methods or deploying new solutions, working closely with Product and Marketing collaborators.
  • Contribute to the delivery of high-quality web application code, maintaining site stability through code reviews and writing unit and integration tests, while learning and applying best practices for architecture, system design, and coding standards.
  • Spend the majority of your time on hands-on coding, with opportunities to learn from and collaborate with more experienced engineers to solve programming and design challenges.
  • Work in an agentic coding workflow as a standard part of daily development — directing tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to plan, implement, test, and review changes across the software development lifecycle. This is a core expectation of the role, not an optional add-on.
  • Contribute your ideas and collaborate with the team to adopt new technologies, being open to learning and adapting to new technology advancements.
  • Participate in our on-call rotation; triage and address reliability issues that come up in the enrollment pipeline, ensuring system stability and resolving critical problems as they arise.

What you need for this role:

  • 3-5 years of experience writing readable, tested, and efficient code
  • Experience with Ruby (preferred) or Python
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Experience with designing scalable, maintainable and secure APIs
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to LLMs and GenAI best practices
  • Hands-on comfort directing AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to plan, implement, and validate changes — beyond simple autocomplete usage
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and deployment tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Willingness to learn new tools, languages, workflows, and philosophies to grow
  • Curiosity and care more about solving problems than being right
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills (verbal and written)

Technologies we use:

Ruby on Rails, React, AWS (RDS with PostgreSQL, SQS, S3), GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Role Title: GitHub Contributor

Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As an expert you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test and AI model's ability to solve complex software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code and optimizing performance.   5. Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality.
  6. Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.

Process:

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SLATEAt Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

Who We Are Looking For

As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top-tier technical talent for Slate's Technology organization to support our company's growth and innovation. You will serve as a true talent advisor — one who brings deep fluency in modern software development disciplines, from frontend and backend engineering to UX/UI design — enabling you to engage authentically with both candidates and hiring teams at a technical level. You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership to understand staffing demand signals from production environments and translate them into hiring strategies that move with urgency and precision. Beyond sourcing and selection, you will own the accountability framework for interview teams, driving structured, consistent evaluation processes that keep quality high and time-to-fill aligned with the pace of business need.

What You Get To Do

Strategic Partnership & Technical Fluency

  • Conduct deep-dive intake meetings with hiring managers across Engineering, Product, and Design to align on role requirements, technical scope, team context, and hiring timelines, going beyond job descriptions to understand the actual architecture, tools, and problems the candidate will be hired to solve.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript, Next.js), backend systems (Node.js, Python, Java, REST/GraphQL APIs), cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP), and UX/UI design principles, enabling you to evaluate candidate profiles with genuine technical discernment.
  • Partner with Engineering leads to understand production demands, sprint cadences, and team capacity gaps, using that context to establish hiring timelines that reflect real-world urgency rather than arbitrary benchmarks.
  • Stay current on evolving tech stacks, architectural patterns, and emerging tools across frontend, backend, and design disciplines so you can credibly represent roles to senior technical candidates and assess fit beyond surface-level keywords.

Interview Team Accountability & Process Integrity

  • Build and enforce a structured interview accountability framework across all hiring teams, defining clear roles, evaluation criteria, and feedback SLAs for every interviewer involved in a loop.
  • Hold hiring managers and interview panels accountable to timely, calibrated, and bias-aware feedback, using data and direct conversation to address delays or inconsistencies that create bottlenecks or risk losing top candidates.
  • Facilitate post-interview debrief sessions that drive decisive, structured decision-making, ensuring panels assess candidates against agreed-upon technical and behavioral competencies rather than gut instinct or unstructured impressions.
  • Proactively identify when interview panel composition, question quality, or evaluation rigor is creating false negatives on strong candidates, and implement corrective calibration sessions to sharpen team judgment.
  • Champion a hiring culture that balances speed with quality, setting expectations with stakeholders that velocity should never come at the cost of bar, while also ensuring that perfect does not become the enemy of good when production needs are pressing.

Sourcing, Recruiting & Candidate Experience

  • Develop and execute multi-channel recruitment strategies to identify and attract qualified candidates through job boards, social media, professional networks, employee referrals, and targeted outreach.
  • Utilize modern sourcing technologies, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM platforms, and talent intelligence solutions to identify and engage passive candidates, particularly senior engineers, UX leads, and full-stack developers who are not actively on the market.
  • Conduct thorough interviews - both technical screening and behavioral - to assess candidates' qualifications, architectural thinking, design sensibility, and cultural alignment, and synthesize findings into clear hire/no-hire recommendations.
  • Build and maintain a living pipeline of passive prospects and warm leads across frontend, backend, and UX disciplines so that when headcount opens, time-to-pipeline is measured in days, not weeks.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience by ensuring transparent communication, timely feedback, and a process that reflects the technical credibility of the team they are joining.

Operations & Metrics

  • Manage the ATS end-to-end, including job postings, candidate tracking, pipeline reporting, and data hygiene, with required proficiency in Workday.
  • Monitor and report on Talent Acquisition KPIs including time-to-fill, time-to-offer, pipeline conversion rates, offer acceptance rates, and interview-to-hire ratios — using data to surface inefficiencies and drive continuous process improvement.
  • Identify and escalate patterns where demand is outpacing pipeline capacity, and work with leadership to adjust sourcing investment, scope, or timeline expectations accordingly.
  • Foster engagement with a diverse talent pool, leveraging inclusive sourcing strategies and structured evaluation practices that expand the quality of the candidate slate.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of recruiting and sourcing experience with a strong focus on high-volume technical hiring for e-commerce and software product companies, spanning Software Engineering (frontend, backend, mobile, full-stack), Technical Product Management, Data Science, UX/UI Design, and Systems Engineering across multiple seniority levels.
  • Demonstrable technical literacy across modern software development stacks, including but not limited to React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Java, REST/GraphQL APIs, AWS, Salesforce, and UX/UI design systems — sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineers and evaluate candidate profiles with real judgment.
  • Proven track record of building and enforcing interview accountability structures that improve panel consistency, reduce time-to-decision, and protect hiring quality under production pressure.
  • Demonstrated ability to align hiring pace with engineering demand signals — balancing urgency with rigor and managing stakeholder expectations across both dimensions.
  • 5+ years of advanced sourcing with LinkedIn Recruiter; familiarity with additional sourcing and talent intelligence platforms strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with Workday ATS required; experience with additional recruiting technology, AI sourcing tools, and CRM platforms strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and influence skills, with a track record of holding hiring teams accountable without damaging the partnership.
  • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Knowledge of employment laws and regulations.

SALARY RANGE

The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Annual Base Pay Range: $105,875 to $158,813 USD

ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.

WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENT

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

  • Safety First

  • Respectful Collaboration

Platform Automation Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Platform Automation Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.
  • Build a library of well-tested, reusable Terraform modules with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.
  • Manage Terraform state at scale with appropriate backend strategies, state locking, workspace organization, and disaster recovery patterns.
  • Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.
  • Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.
  • Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.
  • Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.
  • Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.
  • Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, AI, you will be tasked with extending SentinelOne's engineering capacity directly into the departments that need it most, including Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Security, People, Legal, and beyond. Unlike a platform or product engineer working behind a backlog, you will embed with the stakeholders who own a problem, scope it end to end, and ship a working custom application into their hands, often in days or weeks, not quarters. This role blends hands-on full-stack engineering, rapid prototyping with modern AI tools, and the judgment to know when to build, when to reuse, and when to say no.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Embed with a functional department for a defined engagement, running discovery to understand workflows and pain points before writing a line of code.
  • Scope, design, and build full-stack custom applications (not just automations or scripts) using modern frameworks, AI coding assistants, and internal platform APIs, moving from prototype to production quickly.
  • Own delivery end to end including architecture, build, testing, deployment, and the training and handoff that gets a department to actually adopt what you built.
  • Work hands-on in the code alongside AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to compress build cycles, iterating with stakeholders in near real time rather than through long requirements documents.
  • Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality as requirements shift, and communicate those trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Data teams so every deployed application meets SentinelOne's standards for data security, compliance, and long-term supportability.
  • Codify recurring patterns, components, and playbooks from each engagement into reusable building blocks for the next department and for the broader engineering organization.
  • Feed field learnings back to platform, product, and data teams covering what worked, what broke, and what the next generation of internal tools should look like.
  • Measure and report success through production adoption and measurable business impact, not lines of code shipped or tickets closed.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience with a demonstrated ability to design, build, and ship full-stack applications (frontend and backend) independently.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (Python, Node.js/JavaScript, or comparable) and enough frontend ability to build usable internal tools without waiting on a dedicated design or frontend team.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development, plus a working understanding of APIs, webhooks, data structures, and integration patterns.
  • A track record of working directly with non-technical stakeholders including scoping ambiguous requests, managing expectations, and shipping something real rather than a deck.
  • Comfort operating with significant autonomy and shifting priorities across departments and problem spaces where the right solution is rarely handed to you.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to a functional VP as easily as to a fellow engineer.
  • Prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, professional services, or startup generalist role where you owned a project from discovery through production is preferred.
  • Exposure to enterprise security, compliance, or data governance requirements given the internal, security-conscious environment you will be building in is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Reinsurance Treaty Catastrophe Modeler to join our growing team!

The successful candidate will be responsible for utilizing catastrophe models to accurately assess and quantify the risk and profitability of the Property Cat reinsurance portfolio. You will participate in the reinsurance placement and renewal process and partner closely with the actuarial pricing team, providing crucial insights to support underwriting and management decision-making. This role requires a strong understanding of reinsurance principles, catastrophe modeling software, and statistical analysis.

How You Will Contribute:

  • Treaty Analysis: Analyze and model complex reinsurance treaties (e.g., proportional, non-proportional, retrocessional) using industry-standard catastrophe models (e.g., Verisk Touchstone/Touchstone Re, RMS RiskLink, CoreLogic).
  • Data Preparation & Validation: Prepare, validate, and quality-assure exposure data for input into catastrophe models, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Model Execution & Interpretation: Execute catastrophe models, interpret results (e.g., exceedance probability curves, average annual loss, return periods), and identify key risk drivers.
  • Portfolio Management: Contribute to the management of the reinsurance portfolio by providing risk assessments and insights to underwriters.
  • Scenario Development: Develop and analyze custom scenarios to assess potential impacts of specific events or changes in exposure.
  • Model Validation & Development: Participate in the validation and enhancement of catastrophe models, including model parameterization and calibration.
  • Reporting & Communication: Prepare clear and concise reports summarizing model results and communicate findings to underwriters, management, and other stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with underwriters, actuaries, and other departments to provide comprehensive risk assessments.
  • Research & Development: Stay abreast of industry trends, new modeling techniques, and emerging risks. Participate in projects to help shape and define the company's view of risk for natural catastrophe perils.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in catastrophe modeling, specifically within the reinsurance industry.
  • Proficiency in using at least one major catastrophe modeling platform (Verisk Touchstone, RMS RiskLink, CoreLogic RQE).
  • Strong understanding of reinsurance principles, treaty structures, and underwriting practices.
  • Solid understanding of statistical concepts, including probability distributions, return periods, and extreme value theory.
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using software such as SQL, R, or Python.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills (both written and verbal).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with stochastic modeling tools such as MetaRisk or ReMetrica desired.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, VBA) is a plus.
  • Experience with database management is a plus.

jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $25 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
